sa: विहाय तान् बाणगणानथागतौ सुहृढतावप्रतिमानविक्रमौ। सुखं प्रविष्टौ शिबिरं स्वमीश्वरौ सदस्यनिन्द्याविव विष्णुवासवौ॥
en: Then leaving off those arrows those two great heroes of incomparable prowess, encircled by their well-wishers and friends, returned to their camp like the Lords Indra and Vishnu.

sa: काष्ठलोहतुषाङ्गारदारू शृङ्गास्थिवैणवान्। मज्जा स्नेहवसा क्षौद्रमौषधग्राममेव च॥ शणं सर्जरसं धान्यमायुधानि शरांस्तथा। चर्म स्नायुं तथा वेत्रं मुञ्जबल्वजबन्धनान्॥
en: He should, increase his stores of fuel, iron, chaff, charcoal, timber, horns, bones, bamboos, marrow, oils, clarified butter, fat, honey, medicines, flax, resin, rice, weapons, arrows, leather, catgut, canes, and strings and cords made of Munja grass and other plants and creepers.

sa: याच्यमानेन सततं तव पुत्रेण भारत। घातिता पृथिवी सर्वा वैरस्यान्तं विधित्सता॥
en: Your son, O king, who had constantly been requested (for peace) but who always desired to terminate his hostility after killing the Pandavas has caused the Earth exterminated.

sa: तामहं व्यपनेष्यामि इति कृत्वा व्यवस्थितः। वीरद्युम्नस्तु तं भूयः पप्रच्छ मुनिसत्तमम्॥
en: And he said to himself,-Hope moves every foolish man. I shall banish hope from my mind!-Such was his resolution. Viradyumna once more asked that foremnost of ascetics, saying,

sa: बाहुकण्टकयुद्धेन तस्य कर्णोऽथ युध्यतः। बिभेद सन्धिं देहस्य जरया श्लेषितस्य हि॥
en: While engaged with him a dreadful encounter with bare arms, Karna was about to cut the two portions of his antagonist's body that had been joined by Jara.

sa: अप्रतिब्रुवत: कष्टो दोषो हि भविता प्रभो॥ तस्मात् पुत्रैश्च पौत्रेश्च धर्मान् पृष्टान् सनातनान्। विद्वाजिज्ञासमानस्त्वं प्रब्रूहि भरतर्षभ॥
en: O powerful one if you do not speak on such subjects, you will incur sin. Therefore, questioned by your sons and grandsons, o learned one, about the eternal duties (of men), do you, O foremost of the Bharatas, describe this subject them.

sa: पिबन्तोऽसृग्वसाश्चान्ये क्रुद्धा ब्रह्मद्विषां सदा॥ चतुर्विधात्मकं सोमं ये पिबन्ति च सर्वदा।
en: Worked up with rage, they always drink the blood and fat of all haters of Brahman. They always drink also the Soma juice having four kind of taste.

sa: ज्ञानं तु प्रकृति प्राहुर्तेयं निष्कलमेव च। अज्ञश्च ज्ञश्च पुरुषस्तस्मान्निष्कल उच्यते॥
en: Knowledge, again, is said to be Nature, while the object to be know is called Soul. The Ignorant and the Knowing or Intelligent and both Soul without attributes.

sa: व्यङ्गुलमन्तरम्॥ स तु कर्णस्य तद् दिव्यमस्रमस्रेण शातयन्॥ मायायुद्धेन मायावी सूतपुत्रमयोधयत्।
en: Then the Rakshasa versed in illusion destroying by his own weapon the celestial weapon of Karna, began to fight with Suta's son, aided by his own illusive powers.

sa: यदि गच्छति पातालं ततोऽभ्यधिकमेव वा। सर्वथा रावणस्तात न भविष्यति राघव॥
en: O worshipful one, even if he hide himself in the region under the earth or in a darker quarter, Rāvana shall not be able to draw his breath.

sa: अष्टक उवाच स राजास्त्वकृतप्रज्ञः कामवृत्तश्च पापकृत्। अधर्मेणाभिषास्तूर्वी यस्ते हरति पुष्करम्॥
en: Ashtaka said Let him who has stolen your stalks be a king shorn of wisdom, capricious and sinful in his conduct, and disposed to rule the Earth impiously.

sa: तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वाः पितरश्चाब्रुवन् नृप। एते द्रवन्ति पञ्चलाः पाण्डवाश्च ससैनिकाः॥
en: Then, o king, all the celestials, the Gandharvas and the ancestral manes said-"Behold the Panchalas and the Pandavas, with their troops, fly away from the field of battle!"

sa: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि सूक्ष्मभावकरीं शिवाम्। निवृत्तिं सर्वभूतेषु मृदुना दारुणेन च॥
en: I shall, after this, tell you of renunciation about all entities by means gentle and hard, which produces attachment to subtle topics and which is fraught with auspiciousness.

sa: सपताका रथाश्चैते पञ्चालानां महात्मनाम्॥ पश्य कुन्तीसुतं वीरं बीभत्सुमपराजितम्। प्रधर्षयितुमायान्तं कपिप्रवरकेतनम्॥
en: Behold the heroic Vibhatsu, the son of Kunti, invincible in battle and having a flag with the emblem of a monkey, is coming forward to assail his enemies.

sa: तस्मै पूजां ततोऽकार्षीत् पुरोधाः परमर्षये। स च तां प्रतिजग्राह विधिवन्मन्त्रपूर्वकम्॥
en: The priest (of the Bharatas) then worshipped the great Rishi in the proper form and the Rishi accepted the offerings of the worship with uttering the usual Mantras.

sa: स भूतले भीमबलाभिपिष्टः सुरारिभिस्तैरभिहन्यमानः। जगाम खं कन्दुकवज्जवेन पुनश्च रामेण समाजगाम।०८।।
en: Thus pressed upon the ground with main force and severely struck by the enemies of gods, he flew to the skies like a ball-rolling, and once morejoined Rāma.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच किमर्थं भगवानग्निः प्रनष्टो लोकभावनः॥ विज्ञातश्च कथं देवैस्तन्ममाचक्ष्व तत्त्वतः।
en: Janamejaya said "For what reason did Agni, the Creator of all the worlds, disappear? How also was he found out by the celestials? Tell me all this fully."

sa: वपन् ब्रणे क्षारमिव क्षतानां शत्रुकर्शन। विदीर्यते मे हृदयं त्वया वाक्शल्यपीडितम्॥
en: Like one applying salt on the sores of wounded men, Ogrinder of your foes. Afflicted with your dagger-like words, my heart is on the point of bursting open.

sa: कुमारस्तु ततो द्रोणं सायकेन महाहवे। विव्याधोरसि संक्रुद्धः सिंहवच्च नदन् मुहुः॥
en: Then in that baitle, fierce Kumara. wrought up with ire, pierced, with a shaft, Drona on the chest; and then repeatedly uttered roars like those of the lion.

sa: तेनार्धमाना राजेन्द्र सेना तव विशाम्पते। व्यभ्रश्यत महाराज भिन्ना नौरिव सागरे॥
en: Your army, O king, being thus hard pressed by him, O ruler of the universe, began to roll and tumble like a shattered vessel in the high seas.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा नागराः सर्वे क्रुद्धा राजानमब्रुवन्। असमजं वृणीष्वैकमस्मान् वा राष्ट्रवर्धन॥
en: Seeing him do so, the citizens in a body, waxing wroth spoke to the monarch, 'O enhancer of the kingdom's prosperity, do you either banish Asamañja or us.'

sa: सौतिरुवाच एतत्ते कथितं सर्वममृतं मथितं तथा। यत्र सोऽश्वः समुत्पन्नः श्रीमानतुलविक्रमः॥
en: Sauti said : Thus have I narrated to you how the Ambrosia was churned out of the Ocean, in which the beautiful and powerful horse (Uchchaishrava) was produced.

sa: जोषमास्ख न मां भूयो वक्तुमर्हस्यतः परम्॥ अधरोत्तरमेतद्धि यन्मां त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि।
en: Hold your tongue. It is improper that you shall move after this. I give you this reply from my own lips, you should not address me any longer.

sa: सा वै यथा समादिष्टा तथाऽऽस्ते त्वत्प्रतीक्षिणी दह्यमाना दिवा रात्रौ वस्त्रार्धेनाभिसंवृता॥
en: Indeed, she herself, enjoined by you, remains there, expecting to receive you, clad only in half a piece of cloth and burning whole day and night in sorrow.

sa: प्रीतः कश्चिन्मुनिस्ताभ्यां संस्थितः कलशं ददौ॥ प्रसन्नो वल्कलं कश्चित् ददौ ताभ्यां महायशाः। अन्यः कृष्णाजिनमदाद् यज्ञसूत्रं तथापरः॥
en: Some one in the assembly pleased with them presented them with a water-pitcher; and some one of high fame, being delighted, made them a present of a bark garment; and some one gave them a dark deer skin and some holy thread.

sa: तस्मादवस्थितो भूत्वा ज्ञात्वा लोकस्य निर्णयम्। शृणु युद्धं यथावृत्तं घोरं देवासुरोपमम्॥
en: Therefore, knowing as you do, the fate of this world, quietly and attentively hear how the battle that resembled that between the gods and the Asuras, took place.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रुत्वा दुर्योधनो वाक्यमप्रियं कुरुसंसदि। प्रत्युवाच महाबाहुं वासुदेवं यशस्विनम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Duryodhana, hearing in the assembly of the Kurus those words which he little liked, said in reply to Vasudeva of long arms and of great renown.

sa: शृणु राजन्निदं तत्र प्रोच्यमानं मयानघ। न मेऽभ्यसूया कर्तव्या श्रुत्वैव कुरुसत्तम।॥
en: Kanika said: O sinless king, listen to me as I answer. O best of the Kurus, you should not be angry with me on hearing what I say.

sa: निर्जिता धनुषैकेन शतशः क्षत्रियर्षभाः। काङ्क्षता परलोकं च धर्मराजस्य च प्रियम्॥
en: And hundreds of the foremost of the Kshatriyas were defeated with only one bow by Satyaki, who was desirous of doing good to Dharmaraja and of attaining heaven.

sa: द्रवमाणं तथा क्रुद्धं सात्यकिं पाण्डवो बली॥ प्रस्पन्दमानमादाय जगाम बलिनं बलात्।
en: The puissant Satyaki, who was then furiously rushing (at Dhristadyumna) advanced a few steps, dragging after him the mighty son of Pandu, who was trying to withhold him.

sa: तां तु सेनां तदा भीमो दर्शयन् पाणिलाघवम्। शरैरवचकतॊग्रैः प्रेषयिष्यन् यमक्षयम्॥
en: Bhima then, with his deadly weapons and with great dexterity of hands, waging a ruthless slaughter amongst that body of troops, dispatched them to the region of Pluto.

sa: ततः सशिष्येण मया सूर्येणेव गभस्तिभिः। व्यस्तो यज्ञो महाराज पितुस्तव महात्मनः॥
en: Then, shining in the midst of my disciples like the Sun himself with his rays, I took the management of the Sacrifice, of your noble father, O king.

sa: प्रविष्टोऽपि हि कौन्तेय नेह द्रक्ष्यसि किंचन। न हि मानुषदेहेन शक्यमत्राभिवीक्षितुम्॥
en: O son of Kunti, even if you enter this country, you will not be able to seen any thing, for nothing can be seen here with human eyes.

sa: न ह्ययज्ञा अमुं लोकं प्राप्नुवन्ति कथञ्चन। आपातान् प्रतितिष्ठन्ति पुलिन्दशबरा इव॥
en: Abstaining from sacrifices, sinful persons never attain to heaven. Leaving (this world), they have to pass their time in hell like the degraded tribes of Pulindas and Khasas.

sa: तं यानं शीघ्रमारोप्य सभार्यं सपरिच्छदम्। यावज्जीवं विवास्योऽयमिति तानन्वशात् पिता ॥
en: Then swiftly causing a car to be yoked, he said to his men, “This one is to be banished for life in proper garb along with his wife.

sa: देवाश्च युयुधानस्य ततोऽन्यद् धनुरादाय द्रोणः क्षत्रियमर्दनः॥ अस्त्रैरस्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठो योधयामास भारत।
en: Then taking up another bow, Drona that crusher of Kshatriyas that foremost of those acquainted with the use of weapons, O Bharata, placed some weapons on its string.

sa: तमहं यत्र तत्रस्थं द्रष्टुमिच्छामि सूर्यजम्। अविज्ञातो मया योऽसौ घातितः सव्यसाचिना॥
en: Wherever may that child of the sum be, I wish to see him. Alas, not knowing his relationship with us, I caused him to be killed by Arjuna.

sa: इदं च परितप्यामि पुनः पुनरहं सुराः। यन्मातुः सदृशौ पादौ तस्याहममितात्मनः॥ दृष्ट्वैव तौ नानुगतः कर्णं परबलार्दनम्। न ह्यस्मान् कर्णसहितान् जयेच्छक्रोऽपि संयुगे॥
en: I grieve also continually at this, O gods that when I marked the resemblance between the feet of my mother and those of Karna of high soul, I did not immediately place myself under the orders of that destroyer of hostile ranks! Ourselves joined with Karna, Shakra himself would have been unable to defeat in battle.

sa: का प्रीतिः सत्त्वयुक्तस्य कृत्वोपाधिकृतं जयम्॥ को वा समयभेत्तारं बुधः सम्मन्तुमर्हति।
en: What pleasure can a pious man enjoy after having gained a victory by unfair acts? What wise man would approve of a person's disregarding the rules of equity?

sa: अनुक्रोशो हि साधूनां महद्धर्मस्य लक्षणम्। अनुक्रोशश्च साधूनां सदा प्रीतिं प्रयच्छति॥
en: Kindliness of feeling is the highest test of virtue amongst the good, and this same merciful and humane feeling is the source of eternal happiness to the virtuous,

sa: वृणोमि कीर्ति लोके हि जीवितेनापि भानुमन्। कीर्तिमानश्नुते स्वर्ग हीनकीर्तिस्तु नश्यति॥
en: O Brahmana, I long for renown in this world even at the sacrifice of my life. Men having renown attain to heaven while those having none are lost.

sa: अभ्यवर्षन्त ते सर्वे पाण्डवं निशितैः शरैः। अवाकिरंश्च के म्लेच्छा नानायुद्धविशारदाः॥
en: Began to pour on the son of Pandu their sharp arrows. Those Mlechhas also versed in all modes of war, began to shower on Arjuna their countless shafts.

sa: चकर्ष दोर्ध्यामुत्पात्य भीमो मल्लममित्रहा। निनदन्तमभिक्रोशन् शार्दूल इव वारणम्॥ ततः शब्देन
en: Bhima, the slayer of enemies, seized, with a big seized, his vociferous rival wrestler by the arms and drew him near even as the lion seizes the elephant.

sa: शक्तैविजेतुं तरसा महीं च सत्ये स्थितैः सत्यरथैर्यथावत्। पाण्डोः सुतैस्तग्र व्रतमग्ररूपं वर्षाणि षट् सप्त च चीर्णमग्र्यैः॥
en: The sons of Pandu, who are capable of subjugating the word by sheer force of arms, whose chariots go unrestrained to the celestial or the terrestrial regions and who are true of their words, have fulfilled that austere vow for thirteen years.

sa: न चान्यः पुरुषः कश्चिन्नलं वेत्ति यशस्विनि। गूढश्चरति लोकेऽस्मिन् नष्टरूपे महीपतिः॥
en: O glorious one, no other person knows the whereabouts of king Nala; for a king (in distress) roves about in the world unawares and with an unsightly appearance.

sa: किं तु स्वेनास्मि संतुष्टो दुःखवृत्तिरनुष्ठिता। सेवायां चापि नाभिज्ञः स्वच्छन्देन वनचरः॥
en: I am never satisfied with a little. I have never served another. I am, future more, unskilled in serving. I live according to my pleasure in the forest.

sa: नार्हसे मां सहस्त्राक्ष दुमं त्याजयितुं चिरात्। समर्थमुपजीव्येमं त्यजेयं कथमद्य वै॥ तस्य वाक्येन सौम्येन हर्षित: पाकशासनः। शुकं प्रोवाच धर्मात्मा आनृशंस्येन तोषितः॥
en: You should not, O thousandeyed one, advise me now to leave this tree for good. When it was capable of good, it supported my life. How can I leave it now? Pleased with these wellmeant words of the parrot, the virtuous destroyer of Paka, thus said to him:I am pleased with your humane and merciful disposition.

sa: इमे च मां कर्षयन्ति शिशवो मन्दचेतसः। अबर्दाश्चरङ्गीनाः पूर्वेषां नः परायणाः॥
en: I am filled with sorrow for the sake of these infants with immature understanding and without feathers and feet, who are the sole refuge of our deceased ancestors.

sa: सप्तावरे तथा पूर्वे बान्धवास्ते निमज्जिताः॥ यशसा च परित्यक्तास्त्वां प्राप्य कुलपांसनम्।
en: Having obtained you-the disgrace to their race-for their descendant, seven generations before you and seven after, in your race, have sunk in hell, being deprived of their glory.

sa: आज्ञापयस्व नः पाथै प्रह्वान् प्रेष्यानवस्थितान्। करिष्यामः प्रियं सर्वं तव कौरवनन्दन॥
en: Do you command us, O Partha! Lo, we wait here as the most docile of your servants! O delighter of the Kurus, we shall execute all your commands.'

sa: ते वयं राजवंशेन हीनाः सह सुतैरपि। अवज्ञाता भविष्यामो लोकस्य जगतीपते॥
en: We shall then with all our sons be excluded from the royal line. O lord of the world, we shall be disregarded and hated by all the people.

sa: ददाह भगवान् वह्निर्भूतानीव युगक्षये॥ स हत्वा राक्षसी सेनां शुशुभे सूतनन्दनः।
en: The heroic Karna appeared like the god of fire burning down creatures at the end of a Yuga. Slaying that Rakshasa host, the son of Suta appeared beautiful.

sa: शताद् विशिष्टं यं युद्धे सममन्यन्त वृष्णयः। चेकितानं महेष्वासं कस्तं द्रोणादवारयत्॥
en: That one whom the Vrishnis consider superior in battle to hundred warriors. That mighty warrior Chekitana, what hero of my army tried to keep him away from Drona?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा तु भगवांस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having said this, the deity (Sun) then and there vanished away.

sa: एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं शूलस्य च विपर्ययः। श्रीमतः शितिकण्ठस्य कृत्यं हि दुरतिक्रमम्॥
en: O my son, I have thus told you the way in which the dare should be thwarted. It is impossible to surpass the prowess of the graceful Nilkantha.

sa: आशीविष इव क्रुद्धः सहदेवो यदाभ्ययात्। कदनं करिष्यञ्छत्रूणां तेजसा दुर्जयो युधि॥
en: When Sahadeva, resembling an infuriated snake of mortal poison, rushed at Drona, afflicting his enemies, when that one owning white horses and incapable of being conquered in battle.

sa: माता सत्यवती भीष्ममुवाच तदनन्तरम्॥ जानामि ते स्थितिं सत्ये परां सत्यपराक्रमा इच्छन् सृजेथास्त्रील्लोकानन्यांस्त्वं स्वेन तेजसा॥ जानामि चैवं सत्यं तन्मदर्थे यच्च भाषितम्। आपद्धर्मं त्वमावेक्ष्य वह पैतामही धुरम्॥
en: Having been thus addressed by her son, endued with great effulgence, mother Satyavati, then replied to Bhishma, "O hero whose strength is truth, I know you are devoted to truth. If you like, you can create another three worlds out of your great energy. I know what was your vow on my account. But taking into your consideration the emergency, bear the burden of duty you own towards your ancestors.

sa: प्रीतिं प्राप्यातुलां पूर्वं लोकांश्चात्मवशे स्थितान्। विनिपातमिमं बाह्यं शोचस्याहो न शोचसि॥
en: Formerly all the worlds were under your sway and great was your joy. I ask, do you or you not grieve now, for this loss of your splendour?

sa: यावदस्य शितैर्बाणैः संरम्भं विनयाम्यहम्॥ युद्धश्रद्धां च कौन्तेय जीवितं चास्य संयुगे।
en: I shall smother his wrath with my sharp arrows, as also his itching for battle; O son of Kunti, let me deprive him of his life in battle.

sa: दृष्ट्वा सेनां व्यतिक्रान्तां सात्वतेनार्जुनेन च। पलायमानांश्च कुरून् मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः॥
en: Beholding him of the Satvata race and Arjuna pass through my divisions and beholding the Kurus fly in all directions, Meseems, my sons are giving way to grief.

sa: यस्तु सौवीरराजस्य प्रमथ्य महतीं चमूम्। आदत्त महिषीं भोजां काम्यां सर्वाङ्गशोभनाम्॥
en: That hero who having completely crushed the army of king Sauvira, took for his consort the desirable princess of the Bhojas and graceful in limbs of the body.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच अत्यद्भुतमिदं ब्रह्मन् श्रुतवानस्मि तत्त्वतः। अभिषेकं कुमारस्य विस्तरेण यथाविधि॥
en: Janamejaya said "This history, O Rishi, that I have heard from you is highly wonderful, namely this detailed description of the installation according to due rites of Skanda.

sa: सोऽनुसृत्य महाबाहुर्धन्वी वर्मी रथी ध्वजी। शरैर्विध्वस्य तांश्चौरानवजित्य च तद् धनम्॥
en: He then went away, armed with bow-cased in mail, riding on the chariot and holding the standard. Piercing those thieves with arrows, he took back that wealth (kine).

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच सर्वेषामुपवासानां यच्छ्रेयः सुमहत्फलम्। यच्चाप्यसंशयं लोके तन्मे त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Yudhishthira said You should, O grandfather, tell me what is the highest, the most beneficial, and the most certain fruit of all sorts of fasts in this world.

sa: अविज्ञातासु च स्त्रीषु क्लीबासु स्वैरिणीषु च। परभार्यासु कन्यासु नाचरेन्मैथुनं नृपः॥
en: You should never know unknown women, or the eunuchs, or those who are lewd, or those who are the wives of other men, or those who are unmarried.

sa: ज्ञानेन कर्मणा वापि जरामरणमेव च। व्याधयश्च प्रहीयन्ते प्राप्यते चोत्तमं पदम्॥
en: Those only that are endued with holiness succeed by knowledge and by (virtuous) deeds to conquer disease, decrepitude and death and they alone obtain a very high state.

sa: अलमेव शमायास्मि तथा युद्धाय संजय। धर्मार्थयोरलं चाहं मृदवे दारुणाय च॥
en: I am surely ready for peace and to war as well, O Sanjaya. For the acquirement of wealth, am I surely prepared to mild measures and harsh ones.

sa: ततस्तु तं वानरवीरमुख्यं महाबलं मारुततुल्यवेगम्। महामतिं वायुसुतं वरिष्ठं प्रतुष्टवुर्देवगणाश्च सर्वे॥
en: Thereupon all the celestials praised highly the high-souled, excellent and mighty son of the Wind-god, foremost of heroic monkeys, gifted with the velocity of the of the Wind.

sa: पञ्चालाः सुभृशं क्षीणां: कथामात्रावशेषिताः। न तेषां कुलकर्तारं कंचित् पश्याम्यहं शुभे॥
en: The Panchalas have been wholly rooted out. Only nominally they exist. O auspicious lady, I do not see any one who may assist at their reestablishment and growth.

sa: ते सम्मन्त्र्य ततो देवा मदस्यास्यसमीपगाः। अब्रुवन् सहिताः शक्रं प्रणमास्मै द्विजातये॥
en: While standing within the mouth of Mada, the gods consulted speedily and then addressing Indra, said, Do you soon bend your head in respect to this twiceborn personage.

sa: यज्ञदानतपःशीला नरा वै पुण्यकर्मिणः। येऽभिद्रुह्यन्ति भूतानि ते वै पापकृतो जनाः॥
en: Those men who are devoted to sacrifices, gifts, and penances, are considered as pious. These, however who injure other creatures and are unfriendly to them are considered sinful.

sa: पितामहस्य विदितं किमन्यत् तपसो बलात्। तपसो यत्परं तेऽद्य तन्नो व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: You know very well, O grandfather, that there is nothing whose power is superior to that of Penances. You should explain to us what forms the highest penance.

sa: यच्छोभार्थं बलार्थं वा वित्तमस्ति तवानघ। तेन ते ब्राह्मणाः पूज्याः स्वधर्ममनुतिष्ठता॥
en: Observing the duties of your own caste, do you adore the Brahmanas with whatever riches you have, O sinless one, for purposes of adornment or sustaining your power.

sa: शरीरस्य यथोद्देशाः शुचयः परिकीर्तिताः। तथा पृथिव्या भागाश्च पुण्यानि सलिलानि च॥
en: As special attributes of the body have been said to be sacred, so there are particulars spots on Earth as well, and particular waters, which are considered sacred.

sa: तिलहोमरता विप्राः सर्वे संयतमैथुनाः। समा गव्येन हविषा प्रवृत्तिषु च संस्थिताः॥
en: Those Brahmanas who make Homa with offerings of sesame, abstain from sexual intercourse, and are observant of the religion of Acts, are considered as equal to vaccine Havi.

sa: उभे वाङ्मनसी गत्वा भूतात्मानमपृच्छताम्। आवयोः श्रेष्ठमाचक्ष्व च्छिन्धि नौ संशयं विभो॥
en: Both Word and Mind, repairing to the Soul of matter, asked him, Do you say who amongst us is superior. Do you, O powerful one, remove our doubt.

sa: एतदात्मनि कौरव्य दुष्कृतं विपुलस्तदा। अमन्यत महाभाग तथा तच्च न संशयः॥
en: This was the sin, O you of Kuru's race, which Vipula recollected in himself. Indeed, O blessed king, forsooth, that was the sin which he had actually committed.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्मै शुश्रूषमाणाय भूयः शान्तनवस्तदा। दैवं वंशं यथान्यायमाचष्ट पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Vaishampayana said On this subject, the royal son of Shantanu, ( foremost of men, duly recited the names of the celestials to Yudhishthira who was desirous of hearing.

sa: एष भूताधिपः सर्गः प्रजानां च प्रजापतिः॥ सर्वेषामेव भूतानामहं ब्रह्ममयो महान्।
en: Such is the highest creation among all entities. Prajapati is the lord of all creatures. Of all entities whatever, I, who am full of Brahma, am the foremost.

sa: माघमासे तिलान् यस्तु ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रयच्छति। सर्वसत्त्वसमाकीर्णं नरकं स न पश्यति॥
en: The man who makes gifts of sesame seeds in the month of Magha, to the Brahmanas, has never to see Hell which is full of all dreadful creatures.

sa: जनक उवाच अन्तवन्त इहावस्था विदिताः सर्वकर्मसु। नाध्यगच्छमहं तस्मान्ममेदमिति यद् भवेत्॥
en: Janaka said All conditions here, in all affairs, I understand, are liable to come to an end. Hence, I could not find that which should be called mine.

sa: ततो राजा समुत्थाय धृतराष्ट्रपुरोगमः। पूजामनुपमा चक्रे सर्वे ते च सभासदः॥
en: King Yudhishthira, and all others, headed by Dhritarashtra, stood up and received Brihaspati with proper honours. Excellent was the worship they offered to the preceptor of the celestials.

sa: रोगार्तो मुच्यते रोगाद् बद्धो मुच्येत बन्धनात्। भयान्मुच्येत भीतस्तु मुच्येतापन्न आपदः॥
en: The sick become sound; the afflicted become freed from their miseries; the affrighted become freed from fear, and he who is plunged in calamity becomes freed from calamity.

sa: स गाढवेदनो धीमानालम्ब्य धनुरुत्तमम्। दिव्यं तेजः समाविश्य प्रमीत इव साऽभवत्॥
en: Feeling acute pain, the intelligent Dhananjaya rested awhile, supporting himself on his excellent bow. He stood, having recourse to his celestial energy and seemed externally like one dead.

sa: स तैर्विद्धो महातेजा वज्रदत्तो महामृधे। भृशाहतः पपातोयॊ न त्वेनमजहात् स्मृतिः॥
en: Vajradatta of powerful energy, struck with great force and pierced with those arrows in that fierce encounter, fell down on the Earth. Consciousness, however, did not leave him.

sa: एष प्रसाद्य शिरसा प्रशमार्थमरिंदम॥ याचते त्वां महाबाहो शमं गच्छ धनंजय।
en: O chastiser of enemies this intent seeks to please you by bending his head. He solicits you for peace! O mighty armed hero, be inclined to make peace.

sa: गृहीतं वाजिनं दृष्ट्वा प्रीतात्मा स धनंजयः। पुत्रं रथस्थं भूमिष्ठः संन्यवारयदाहवे॥
en: Seeing the horse seized, Dhananjaya become filled with joy. Standing on the earth, that hero began to oppose the advance of his son who was on his car.

sa: अयं हि सर्वधर्माणां धर्मश्चिन्त्यतमो मतः। कीदृशस्य प्रदेया स्यात् कन्येति वसुधाधिप।॥
en: I think this should be considered as the foremost of all duties. Tell me, however, O king, to what sort of a person should one give his daughter.

sa: स ददर्श तमासीनं विपुलस्य कलेवरम्। निश्चेष्टं स्तब्धनयनं यथा लेख्यगतं तथा॥
en: He beheld the body of Vipula staying in a sitting posture, immovable as a stake and with eyes shorn of vision, like a picture drawn on the canvas.

sa: भीष्म उवाच विपुलस्त्वकरोत् तीव्र तपः कृत्वा गुरोर्वचः। तपोयुक्तमथात्मानममन्यत स वीर्यवान्॥
en: Bhishma said Having satisfied his preceptor's command, Vipula practised the most severe penances. Gifted with great energy, he at last regarded himself as endued with sufficient ascetic merit.

sa: यावतः साधुधर्मान् वै सन्तः संवर्धयन्त्युत। सर्वस्वैश्चापि भर्तव्या नरा ये बहुकारिणः॥
en: The righteous support and advance the cause of virtue. One should, by giving up his all, support such men as also those who do good to all creatures.

sa: न हि त्वां गौरवेणाहमशकं वक्तुमञ्जसा। गमनं प्रति राजेन्द्र तदिदं समुपस्थितम्॥
en: From my respect for you, however, I could not speedily speak on the subject of our journey to the forest. The time for that sojourn in now come.

sa: व्यास उवाच कीटसंत्रस्तरूपोऽसि त्वरितश्चैव लक्ष्यसे। क्व धावसि तदाचक्ष्व कुतस्ते भयमागतम्॥
en: Vyasa said O worm, you appear to be greatly alarmed and to be in great haste. Tell me, where do you run and whence have you been afraid?

sa: दिष्ट्या द्रक्ष्यामि तां कुन्ती वर्तयन्ती तपस्विनीम्। जटिलां तापसी वृद्धां कुशकाशपरिक्षताम्॥
en: By good luck I shall see Kunti performing penances, with matted locks on her head, practising severe austerities, and emaciated by sleeping on blades of Kusha and Kasha.

sa: युधिष्ठिराभ्यनुज्ञाताः सर्वं तद् व्यभजन् द्विजाः।।२५ अनन्तरं द्विजातिभ्यः क्षत्रिया जहिरे वसु।
en: After the Brahmanas had taken as much as they wished, the wealth that remained was taken away by Kshatriyas and Vaishyas and Shudras and various tribes of Mlecchas.

sa: नैते देवैर्न पितृभिर्न गन्धर्वैर्न राक्षसैः। नासुरैर्न पिशाचैश्च शक्या जेतुं द्विजातयः॥
en: These twice born persons are incapable of being defeated by the deities or the departed manes, or the Gandharvas or the Rakshasas, or the Asuras or the Pishachas.

sa: सम्प्राप्य तानि प्रीतात्मा गुरोर्वचनकारकः। तदा जगाम तूर्णं च चम्पां चम्पकमालिनीम्॥
en: The accomplisher of his his preceptor's command, having obtained them, he felt great delight and started quickly for the city of Champa adorned with festoons of Champaka flowers.

sa: अधर्मेण समायुक्तो यमस्य विषयं गतः। महद् दुःखं समासाद्य तिर्यग्योनौ प्रजायते॥
en: Endued with sin, individual soul has to go the dominions of Yama and suffering great misery there he has to take birth in an intermediate order of being.

sa: त्वयि प्राणा ममायत्ता: कुरुणां कुरुनन्दन। स कस्मात् प्राणदोऽन्येषां प्राणान् संत्यक्तवानसि॥
en: My life-breaths depend on you, O delighter of the Kurus. How is it that he who is the ver of other people's life-breaths, renounces his own life-breaths today?

sa: तपसा महदाप्नोति विद्यया चेति नः श्रुतम्। तपसैव चापनुदेद् यच्चान्यदपि दुष्कृतम्॥
en: With the help of penances and of knowledge one acquires the highest fruits.; It is by penances that onc dissipates his sins and all else that is evil.

sa: परदारेषु ये चापि चक्षुर्दुष्टं प्रयञ्जते। तेन दुष्टस्वभावेन जात्यन्धास्ते भवन्ति ह॥
en: Those men of foolish understandings who cast wicked eyes upon the married wives of other men, become cursed with congenital blindness on account of that sinfulness of theirs.

sa: शृणोत्ययं प्रोच्यमानं गृह्णाति च यथातथम्। पृच्छतस्तदतो भूयो गुरुरन्यो न विद्यते॥
en: It is that one who hears himself when speaking, and understands it duly. Once, again, is that heard from him when he speaks. There is no second preceptor.

sa: पूषणं चाभिदुद्राव पादेन च रुषान्वितः। पुरोडाशं भक्षयतो दशनान् वै व्यशातयत्॥
en: Excited with anger, he attacked Pushan with his foot. He tore out the teeth of that god as he satemployed in cating the large sacrificial ball (called Purodasha).

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कीदृशेभ्यः प्रदातव्यं भवेच्छ्राद्धं पितामह। द्विजेभ्यः कुरुशार्दूल तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: Yudhishthira said. You should, O foremnost one of Kuru's race, tell me to what kind of Brahmanas, O grandfather, should the offers made at Shraddhas, be given away.

sa: समागतस्ततो व्यासः शतयूपादिभिर्वृतः। धृतराष्ट्रं महीपालमास्यतामित्यभाषत।॥
en: Approaching near, Vyasa, surrounded by Shatayupa and others, addressed king Dhritarashtra, saying, 'Be seated.'

sa: घ्राण जिह्वा ततश्चक्षुः श्रोत्रं बुद्धिर्मनस्तथा। न स्पर्शानधिगच्छन्ति त्वक् च तानधिगच्छति॥
en: The nose, the tongue, the eye too, the ear, the understanding, and the mind, succeed in apprehending sensations of touch. It is the skin alone that apprehends them.

sa: प्रभाव एष वो गावः प्रतिगृह्णीत मामिह। नावमन्या ह्यहं सौम्यास्त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे॥
en: You who have such energy, do you take me! You amiable ones, I am never dishonoured by any one in the three worlds of mobile and immobile creatures.

sa: तच्छुत्वा स मुनिस्तुष्टो विपुलस्य प्रतापवान्। बभूव शीलवृत्ताभ्यां तपसा नियमेन च॥
en: Hearing these words of Vipula, that foremost of Munis, gifted with great prowess, became highly pleased with him for his conduct and disposition, his penances and his observances.

sa: यथा धावति गौर्वत्सं सवन्ती वत्सला पयः। एवमेव महाभाग भूमिर्भवति भूमिदम्॥
en: As an affectionate cow runs towards her half, with full udders dropping milk, similarly the highly blessed Earth, runs towards the person who makes a gift of earth.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच त्वमेवैतन्महाबाहो वक्तुमर्हस्यरिंदम। त्वं गतिः सर्वभूतानामिति मे निश्चिता मतिः॥
en: Vasudeva said O mighty-armed one, what you say is worthy of you, O chastiser of enemies! You are the goal of all creatures. This is my certain conclusion.

sa: ततो महर्षयः प्रीतास्तथेत्युक्त्वा पुरंदरम्। सहैय त्रिदशेन्द्रेण सर्वे जग्मुस्त्रिविष्टपम्॥ एवमेते महात्मानो भोगैर्बहुविधैरपि। क्षुधा परमया युक्ताश्छन्द्यमाना महात्मभिः॥ नैव लोभं तदा चक्रस्ततः स्वर्गमवाप्नुवन्॥
en: Bhishma said The great Rishis, highly pleased at this, replied to Purandara, saying, So be it! They then ascended to the celestial region the company of Indra himself. Even this, those high souled Rishis giving up all foods and other desirable articles as they are not touched with greed and they obtained the abode of heaven.

sa: यावद् भूमेरायुरिह तावद् भूमिद एधते। न भूमिदानादस्तीह परं किंचिद् युधिष्ठिर॥
en: As long as the earth lasts, so long does the giver thereof grow rich. There is no gift that is higher, O Yudhishthira, than the gift of earth.

sa: एवं स राजा धर्मात्मा परीत्याश्रममण्डलम्। वसु विश्राण्य तत् सर्वं पुनरायान्महीपतिः॥
en: Pious king Yudhishthira, having thus roved through the forest and seen the various retreats of ascetics and made many gifts, returned to the place where his uncle was.

sa: दानानामपि सर्वेषां गवां दानं प्रशस्यते। गावः श्रेष्ठाः पवित्राश्च पावनं ह्येतदुत्तमम्॥
en: Of all kinds of gifts, the gift of kine is spoken highest of. Kine are the foremost of all things. Themselves sacred, they are the best of purifier.

sa: ब्राह्मणस्वं न हर्तव्यं पुरुषेण विजानता। ब्राह्मणस्वं हृतं हन्ति नृगं ब्राह्मणगौरिव॥
en: No one should knowingly misappropriate anything belonging to a a Brahmana. The property of Brahmana, if take, destroys the taker even as the Brahmana's cow destroyed king Nriga!

sa: प्रसीद मातर्मा गास्त्वं वनमद्य यशस्विनि। श्रियं यौधिष्ठिरी मात(क्ष्व तावद् बलार्जिताम्॥
en: Relent, O mother! O you of great fame, do not go into the forest now! Do you enjoy that prosperity which, acquired by power, has become Yudhishthira's today.

sa: वाक्येनतेन हि तदा तं जनं पुरुषर्षभः। ह्लादयामास स विभुर्धर्मार्ते सलिलैरवि॥
en: The powerful Krishna, that foremost of men, by uttering these words, pleased all the people assembled there, like one pouring cold water on a person afflicted with sweat.

sa: मृतकस्य त्रिरात्रे यः समुद्दिष्टे समश्नुते। सप्त त्रिषवणं स्नात्वा पूतो भवति ब्राह्मणः॥ सिद्धिमाप्नोति विपुलामापदं चैव नाप्नुयात्॥
en: The Brahmana who takes his food in the house of a dead person for three nights becomes purified by performing his ablutions thrice daily for seven days, and thus gains all the objects of his desire, and is never troubled by misfortunes.

sa: पितृमातृसमायोगे पुत्रत्वं जायते यथा। हिंसां कृत्वावशः पापो भूयिष्ठं जायते तथा॥
en: The union of father and mother produces children, Similarly the cruelty that a helpless and sinful wretch commits, produces its progeny of repeated rebirths fraught with great misery.

sa: स राजाग्नीन् पर्युपास्य हुत्वा च विधिवत् तदा॥ संध्यागत सहस्रांशुमुपातिष्ठत भारत।
en: Sitting near his own fire, he poured libations on it according to due rites, and then adored the thousand-raycd sun as he was on the point of setting.

sa: व्यास उवाच अनुजानाभि राजंस्त्वां क्रियतां यदनन्तरम्। यजस्व वाजिमेधेन विधिवद् दक्षिणावता॥
en: Vyasa said I give you permission, O king, Do what should be done after this. Do you adore the deities duly by performing the Horse-Sacrifice with profuse gifts.

sa: अलोभकाम्यया देवि तपसा च शुभानने। प्रसन्नोऽहं वरं तस्मादमरत्वं ददामि ते॥
en: You will live in a region that is higher than the three worlds, through my favour. That region shall be known to all by the name of Goloka.

sa: इति वेदोक्तमृषिभिः पुरस्तात् परिकल्पितम्। इदानीं चैव नः कृत्यं पुरस्ताच्च परिश्रुतम्॥
en: The Rishis of old said this, following the ordinances laid down in the Vedas. These injunctions of yore, should certainly be followed by us even in our times.

sa: वैश्याः शूद्राश्च यन्मोहादुपवासं प्रचक्रिरे। त्रिरात्रं या द्विरात्रं वा तयोर्तुष्टिर्न विद्यते॥
en: Fast for one night is ordained for Vaishyas and Shudras. If they observe fasts for two or three nights by mistake, such fasts never bring on their advancement.

sa: गुणवान् विगुणानन्यान् नूनं पश्यसि सत्कृतान्। प्राज्ञोऽप्राज्ञान् विनीतात्मा तेनासि हरिणः कृशः॥
en: Persons having riches much greater than yours but inferior to you in merit, are indeed, disregarding you. It is for this that you are so pale and lean.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा बहु सान्त्वादिप्रसादमकराज्जयः॥ परिष्वज्य च तां प्रीतो विससर्ज गृहानं प्रति॥
en: Having said so, Dhananjaya comforted his sister and became inclined to make peace. Cheerfully, he embraced her and then dismissed her, asking her to return to her palace.

sa: तत्र श्रुतिस्तु परमा सुवर्णं दक्षिणेति वै। एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं पितामह यथातथम्॥
en: The Shrutis, however, declare that of all presents, gold is very superior and is, indeed, the best. I wish, O grandfather, to hear you describe truly this subject.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा स नृपतिः प्रविवेश रसातलम्। उक्त्वाथ वितथं प्रश्नं चेदीनामीश्वरः प्रभुः॥
en: Having answered the question thus, he had to enter the nether regions. Indeed, the powerful king of the Chedis had to undergo that misery for having answered falsely.

sa: कुटुम्बार्थं समानीतं यत्किञ्चित् कार्यमेव तु। प्रातरुत्थाय तत्सर्वं कारयामि करोमि च॥
en: Rising early in the morning I did and caused to be done whatever was brought about and required to be done for the sake of relatives and kinsmen.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच राज्यं प्रतिगमिष्यामः शिवेन प्रतिनन्दिताः॥ अनुज्ञातास्त्वया राजन् गमिष्यामो विकल्मषाः।
en: Yudhishthira said Delighted by auspicious blessings, we shall return to the capital. Indeed, O king having received your permission, we shall leave this hermitage freed from every sin.

sa: ततस्ते सुमहच्चैव बलवच्च सुवर्तितम्। अवतीर्य ततः सर्वे जालं चकृषिरे तदा॥
en: Getting down into the water, all of them began to drag with great force that net which was very large and had been wellspread over a large space.

sa: ब्राह्मणं जनको राजा सन्नं कस्मिंश्चिदागसि। विषये मे न वस्तव्यमिति शिष्ट्यर्थमब्रवीत्॥
en: King Janaka (on a certain occasion), desirous of punishing him said to a Brahmana who had become guilty of some offence, You shall not live within my dominions.

sa: द्विकालमग्निं जुह्वानः शुचिर्भूत्वा समाहितः। धारयीत सदा दण्डं बैल्वं पालाशमेव वा॥
en: He should pour libations on the fire twice a day, having purified himself and with concentrated mind. He should always carry a staff made of Bilva or Palasha.

sa: भीष्म उवाच विज्ञाय यातुधानीं तां कृत्यामृषिवधैषिणीम्। अत्रिः क्षुधापरीतात्मा ततो वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Bhishma said Ascertaining that her name was Yatudhani and that she stood there for killing thein, Atri, who was famishing with hunger, addressed her and said those words.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रश्च तान् सर्वान् विनीतान् नियमे स्थित्तान्॥ शिष्यवृत्तिं समापन्नान् गुरुवत् प्रत्यपद्यत।
en: Dhritarashtra also, seeing them so humble and obedient to his commands and acting towards him as disciples towards preceptors, treated them also like a loving preceptor in return.

sa: सर्प उवाच सुप्रज्ञमपि चेच्छूरमृद्धिर्मोहयते नरम्। वर्तमानः सुखे सर्वो मुह्यतीति मतिर्मम॥
en: The Serpent said : Even a highly intellectual and wise man is inflated with prosperity. And in my opinion those that are given to luxury lose their sense.

sa: इति नन्दिवचः श्रुत्वा क्रोधात्कम्पितकुण्डलः॥ रोषात्तु ताम्रनयनः पुष्पकादवरुह्य सः। कोऽयं शंकर इत्युक्त्वा शैलमूलमुपागतः॥ सोऽपश्यन्नन्दिनं तत्र देवस्यादूरतः स्थितम्। दीप्तं शूलमवष्टभ्य द्वितीयमिव शंकरम्॥
en: Hearing Nandi's speech, (Ravana), wrought up with wrath, his eyes coppery, and his earrings shaking, leapt down from Puspaka. And saying, 'who is this Sankara? and he came down to the base of the mount. He beheld there Nandi stationed at the side of the deity, supporting himself on his flaming dart, resembling a second Sankara.

sa: बालोऽपि यौवनं प्राप्तो मानुषेषु विशाम्पते। सर्वास्त्रेषु परं वीरः प्रकर्षमगमद् बली॥
en: He grew up to be a youth when he was a boy and that mighty hero soon acquainted high proficiency in all arms and weapons known amongst mankind.

sa: नान्तं सर्वविधित्सानां गतपूर्वोऽस्ति कश्चन। शरीरे जीविते चैव तृष्णा मन्दस्य वर्धते॥
en: No one could ever attain to the end of desire. Only he who is destitute of knowledge and judgement feels and avidity for protecting his body and life.

sa: मिच्छामि त्वां द्रष्टुमहं तथैव। तेनैव रूपेण चतुर्भुजेन सहस्रवाहो भव विश्वमूर्ते॥
en: I desire to see you as before, with diadem, discus and mace. O you of thousand arms, O you of universal form, be of that four armed form.

sa: कुशली यदि काकुत्स्थः किं न सागरमेखलाम्। मही दहति कोपेन युगान्ताग्निरिवोत्थितः॥
en: And if Kākutstha lives untouched by ill, then why does he not burn the earth, encircled by the ocean with his ire like to the fire of dissolution?

sa: राजा हि वीर्यवांस्तात इक्ष्वाकुरपराजितः॥ बृहदश्व इति ख्यातो भविष्यति महीपतिः। तस्य पुत्रः शुचिर्दान्तः कुवलाश्व इति श्रुतः॥
en: O child, a mighty and invincible king of the race of Ikshvaku, known by the name of Brihadashva, will be the ruler over earth. His son will be very illustrious, self-controlled and holy; he will be known by the name of Kuvalashva.

sa: सर्वे स्वविषये श्रेष्ठाः सर्वे चान्योन्यधर्मिणः। इति तानब्रवीत् सर्वान् समवेतान् प्रजापति॥
en: All are foremost in their own spheres, and all possess the attributes of one another! The Lord of all creatures, thus said to them, that were assembled together.

sa: हनूमन्यत्नमास्थाय दुःखक्षयकरो भव। स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय मारुतिर्भीमविक्रमः॥ शिरसाऽऽवन्द्य वैदेहीं गमनायोपचक्रमे।
en: O Hanumān, undergoing toils, be you instrumental in removing my misery. Saying, "So be it,” the Wind-god's offspring of terrible prowess, bowing down the head, prepared to depart.

sa: विमृज्य बाष्पं परिसान्त्व्य चासकृत् स लक्ष्मणं राघववंशवर्धनः। उवाच पित्रोर्वचने व्यवस्थित निबोध मामेष हि सौम्य सत्पथः॥
en: That descendant of Raghu, wiping tears off the eyes of Lakşmaņa and consoling him repeatedly, spoke to him saying “Oh gentle one, I have thought it to be the best way by all means that I shall abide by my father's orders."

sa: शिबिरौशीनरो धीमानुवाच मधुरां गिरम्। यथा बालेषु नारीषु वैहार्येषु तथैव च॥
en: The wise Shibi, the son of Ushinara, then said in a sweet voice Since, to children, or women, as also to those who might be cracked jokes with,

sa: प्रदाय गूढानि वसूनी राजन् प्रच्छिद्य भोगानवधाय च स्वान्। दुष्टान् स्वदोषैरिति कीर्तयित्वा पुरेषु राष्ट्रेषु च योजयन्ति॥
en: Presenting them wealth privately, and confiscating their properties publicly, without, however, injuring them materially, and proclaiming that they are all wicked men who have suffered for their own misdeeds, kings should despatch their agents to the cities and provinces of their enemies.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अनुयुक्तः स मेधावी लोकधर्मविधानवित्। उवाच श्लक्ष्णया वाचा प्रह्लादमनपार्थया॥
en: Thus questioned by by Prahlada, that intelligent Brahmana who was well-conversant with the duties of the world, answered him in words of melodious sounds and of great significance.

sa: आगच्छ नरशार्दूल मुक्तास्ते चैव कल्मषात्॥ स्वपक्ष्याश्चैव ये तुभ्यं पार्थिवा निहता रणे। सर्वे स्वर्गमनुप्राप्तास्तान् पश्य भरतर्षभ॥
en: Come, o king, all of them have been purged of their sins. All those kings who had sided you and who have been killed in battle, have all acquired the celestial region. Come and see them, O foremost one of Bharata's race.

sa: भीष्म उवाच श्रूयतां देवदेवस्य नामान्यद्भुतकर्मणः। गूढव्रतस्य गुह्यानि प्रकाशानि च भारत॥
en: Bhishma said Hear, O Bharata, what the names, both secret and public, are of that god of gods, that god of extraordinary feats, that ascetic of secret VOWS.

sa: न राजा कुपितो राम व्यसनं नास्य किंचन। किंचिन्मनोगतं त्वस्य त्वद्भयात्रानुभाषते॥
en: Oh Rāma, the monarch is not angry nor has any danger befallen him. He has got something in his mind which he cannot speak out through your fear.

sa: भीमसेनस्तु तद् दृष्ट्वा तस्य कर्म महात्मनः। अधिसेनापतिं चक्रे सुधर्माणं महाबलम्॥
en: Fought a fearful battle with Bhima without any arms. Seeing the feat of that illustrious (king), Bhimasena installed installed the mighty Sudharma as the generalissimo (of his army).

sa: यत्र ते पुरुषव्याघ्राः शूरा विगतमन्यवः। पाण्डवा धार्तराष्ट्राश्च स्वानि स्थानानि भेजिरे॥
en: Indeed, he reached that place where those foremost of men, those heroes, viz., the Pandavas and the Dhartarashtras, freed from (human) wrath, were enjoying each his respective position.

sa: शृणोति श्रावयेद् वापि सततं चैव यो नरः। सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो वैष्णवं पदमाप्नुयात्॥
en: The man who listens to the Bharata) or that recites it to other people becomes purged of all his sins and acquires. at last the status of Vishnu.

sa: अथवा दुर्मरं तात यदिदं मे सहस्रधा। पतिपुत्रविहीनाया हृदयं न विदीर्यते॥
en: O father, difficult of destruction is my heart since, though I am deprived of husband and child, that heart of mine does not brcak into a thousand pieces.

sa: विक्रमे चाप्यपर्याप्ताः पाण्डवान् प्रति भारत। न हीमे सर्ववराजानः पर्याप्ताः सहितास्त्वया॥
en: They are not competent too in prowess or in strength, to be a match against the sons of Pandu; nor are all these kings united with you competent,

sa: अहं विजानामि विशालनेत्रे ध्यानेन हीना न विदन्त्यसन्तः। तवाद्य मोहेन च सेन्द्रदेवा लोकास्त्रयः सर्वत एव मूढाः॥
en: O lady having large eyes, I know that it is only the sinful, who shorn of contemplation, that do not understand me. It is through your power of illusion that the gods headed by Indra and the three worlds all become stupefied.

sa: स्वपल्यामाहितो गर्भ उतथ्येन महात्मना॥ उतथ्येऽन्तर्हिते चैव कदाचिद्देवमायया। बृहस्पतिस्थाविन्दत्पत्नीं तस्य महात्मनः॥
en: The great Utathya having impregnated his wife disappeared from her side through an illusion of the gods. The younger brother Brihaspati then appeared before that great one's wife.

sa: भीष्म उवाच यथाऽऽचरितमेवात्र शस्त्रं पत्रं विधीयते। आचाराद् वीरपुरुषस्तथा कर्मसु वर्तते॥
en: Bhishma said The soldier should use those weapons and cars with which they have become familiar by use. Taking those weapons and vehicles, brave soldiers, engage in battle.

sa: दैवं पुरुषकारेण यः समर्थः प्रबाधितुम्। न दैवेन विपत्रार्थः पुरुषः सोऽवसीदति॥
en: He, who can avert the consequences of destiny by dint of his manliness, does not lose heart even in the face of his interest being endangered by it.

sa: तौ नासत्यावश्विनौ वां महेऽहं स्रजं च यां विभृथः पुष्करस्य। तौ नासत्यावमृतावृतावृधावृते देवास्तत् प्रपदे न सूते॥
en: O Ashvinis, I worship you. I also worship the sky that is your handiwork. You are the ordainers of the fruits of all acts from which even the celestials are not free; you are, however, free from the fruits of your actions.

sa: इत्युक्तः प्रत्युवाचेदं व्यासो वेदविदां वरः। साधु सर्वमिदं भाव्यमेवमेतद् यथाऽऽत्य माम्॥
en: are Thus addressed by Kunti, Vyasa, that foremost of all persons, said to her in reply, "Blessed be you, all that you have said to me will happen.

sa: यदा श्राद्धं पितृभ्योऽपि दातुमिच्छेत मानवः। तदा पश्चात् प्रकुर्वीत निवृत्ते श्राद्धकर्मणि॥
en: When a man wishes to offers Shraddha to his ancestors, he should, when the Shraddha ceremony is donc, please his ancestors and then make the Bali offerings duly.

sa: ज्ञानं चैवात्र बुद्धिश्च मनश्च भरतर्षभ। तस्य भोगाधिकरणे करणानि निबोध मे॥
en: O the best of the Bharatas, know that the senses, the mind and the intellect assisting the soul in its enjoyment of the perceptible objects are called Karanas.

sa: एष मातुर्वियोगाच्च क्षुधया च भृशार्दितः। रुरोद शिशुरत्यर्थ शिशुः शरवणे यथा।२२॥
en: Being distressed with hunger on account of the absence of the mother, Hanuman, just born, cried like Kartikeya, the commander-in-chief of the celestials, in the forest of Saras.

sa: त्वमग्ने यज्ञानां होता विश्वेषां हितो देवानां मानुषाणां च जगत इति॥
en: You, O Agni, are the Hota in sacrifices, and the benefactor of the universe. You are the benefactor of the gods, of men and of all the worlds.

sa: पवनस्य ह्रदे स्नात्वा मरुतां तीर्थमुत्तमम्। तत्र स्नात्वा नरव्याघ्र विष्णुलोके महीयते॥
en: Going to the lake of Pavana, which is a excellent Tirtha called Maruta and bathing there, O foremost of men, one is adored in the regions of Vayu.

sa: सन्ति देवनिकायाश्च संकल्पाज्जनयन्ति ये। वाचा दृष्ट्या तथा स्पर्शात् संघर्षेणेति पञ्चधा।॥
en: There many deities. They beget (offspring) by thought alone. By word, by sight, by touch, and by sexual union, also, they beget children. These are the five methods.

sa: एतास्तु द्रुपदं वृद्धं स्नुषा भार्याश्च दुःखिताः। दग्ध्वा गच्छन्ति पाञ्चाल्यं राजानमपसव्यतः॥
en: Having burnt his body on the funeral pyre, the daughter-in-law and the wives of the old king, stricken with sorrow, are proceeding, keeping the pyre to their right.

sa: सर्वमेतद् यथोक्तं ते भविष्यति न संशयः॥ विचरिष्यन्ति भद्रं ते देवरूपास्तवात्मजाः।
en: All this that you have said must come to pass; there is no doubt about it. Good betide you, your sons endowed with celestial forms, shall range about.

sa: त्वां तु जानाम्यहं देवं पुराणमृषिसत्तमम्। नरेण सहितं देव वदर्यां सुचिरोषितम्॥
en: I know thee, O illustrious one, to be that ancient and best of Rishis who lived for many years in the company of Nara, in hermitage of Badari.

sa: मज्जेत् त्रयी दण्डनीतौ हतायां सर्वे धर्माः प्रक्षयेयुर्विबुद्धाः। सर्वे धर्माश्चाश्रमाणां हताः स्युः क्षात्रे त्यक्ते राजधर्मे पुराणे॥
en: If the science of punishment disappears, the Vedas will be lost. All these scriptures also describing the duties of men become lost. Indeed, if these ancient duties the Kshatriyas be abandoned, all the duties of all the modes of life, become lost.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततोऽतीते महाकल्पे उत्पन्नेऽङ्गिरसः सुते। बभूवुर्निर्वृता देवा जाते देवपुरोहिते॥
en: Bhishma said Then, upon the expiration of the great cycle, when the celestial priest Brihaspati was born in the family of Angiras, all the gods became very happy.

sa: वीरभद्र उवाच नाहं रुद्रो न वा देवी नैव भोक्तुमिहागतः॥ देव्या मन्युकृतं मत्वा क्रुद्धः सर्वात्मकः प्रभुः।
en: Virabhadra said I am neither Rudra nor his consort the goddess Uma. Nor have I come here for partaking of the food. Knowing the fact of Uma's anger, the powerful Lord who is the soul of all creatures has yielded to anger.

sa: अतिरात्रस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः। प्राप्नुयाच्च क्रतुफलं तथा पर्वणि पर्वणि॥
en: By doing this, one acquires the merits of the Atiratha sacrifice. Indeed, at each successive Parva, he acquires the merits which belong to the performance of a sacrifice.

sa: स्वधीते यत् फलं वेदे तदस्मिन्नपि पर्वणि। क्षत्रियाणामभीरूणां युक्तमत्र महद् यशः॥
en: The fruits that arise from a study of the Vedas, arise from the reading of this Parvan also. The great achievements of brave Kshatriyas have bee described here.

sa: अतिसृज्य ददानीति वरं मम विशाम्पतिः। स निरर्थं गतजले सेतुं बन्धितुमिच्छति॥
en: Promising 'I give you the lord of earth granted me these boons; in vain he wishes to set up a dyke when all the water has passed away.

sa: नमोऽस्तु कृशनासाय कृशाङ्गाय कृशाय च। संहृष्टाय विहृष्टाय नमः किलकिलाय च॥
en: Salutations called Krishanasha, who are of thin limbs, and who are thin. Salutations to you who are always cheerful and who are the personification of sounds and voices.

sa: यथा प्रदीप्तं ज्वलनं पतङ्गा विशन्ति नाशाय समृद्धवेगाः। स्तवापि वक्त्राणि समृद्धवेगाः॥
en: As insects for their own destruction rush in increasing speed into the blazing fire, so these men, with unceasing speed enter into your mouth for their own destruction.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा ततः पार्थः शरैरस्त्रानुमन्त्रितैः। प्रववर्ष दिशः कृत्स्ना: शब्दवेधं च दर्शयन्॥
en: Saying this, Partha displaying his skill in hitting at an invisible object by sound alone, entirely covered all the sides by discharges of arrows inspired with the mantras,

sa: त एतदीदृशं कुर्युर्यथा त्वं तात मन्यसे। धर्मार्थयुक्ता लोकेऽस्मिन् प्रवृत्तिर्लक्ष्यते सताम्॥
en: These latter alone act in the way that you are contemplating; in this world the inclination of honest men seems to lie towards and virtue and worldly profit.

sa: क्लि श्नीयुरपि हिंस्युर्वा यदि राजा न पालयेत्॥ वधबन्धपिरक्लेशो नित्यमर्थवतां भवेत्।
en: If the king did not protect, all persons possessing wealth would have to meet with death, imprisonment and persecution and the very idea of property would be lost.

sa: न च शत्रुरवज्ञेयो दुर्बलोऽपि बलीयसा। अल्पोऽपि हि दहत्यग्निविषमल्पं हिनस्ति च॥
en: The king, even if very powerful, should not neglect a foe however weak. A scintillation of fire can produce a conflagration and a particle of Poison can kill.

sa: बाहुं सवजं तं तस्य क्रुद्धस्यास्तमभयत् प्रभुः॥ प्रहस्य भगवांस्तूर्णं सर्वलोकेश्वरो विभुः।
en: Thereupon the all-powerful Lord of all the worlds, possessed of the six excellent qualities the Bhagas, smilingly paralysed the arm of the enraged Indra wielding the thunder bolt.

sa: सोहमनुज्ञातो भवता इच्छामीष्टं गुर्वर्थमुपहर्तुमिति। तनेवैमुक्त उपाध्यायः प्रत्युवाच-'वत्सोत्तङ्क! उष्यतां तावत्' इति॥
en: I, who have got your permission to go, wish to bring some Dakshina for you.” On hearing this, his preceptor said, "Uttanka, my child, then wait some time."

sa: स्वधीते यत् फलं वेदे तदस्मिन्नपि पर्वणि। क्षत्रियाणामभीरूणां युक्तमत्र महद् यशः॥
en: The fruits that arise from a study of the Vedas, arise from the reading of this Parvan also. The great achievements of brave Kshatriyas have bee described here.

sa: नूनं ते हृदयं काम वज्रसारमयं दृढम्। यदनर्थशताविष्टं शतधा न विदीर्यते॥
en: Without doubt, O Desire, your heart is hard like that of an adamant, since though affected by a hundred reverses, you do not break into as many fragments.

sa: तृणं च मुसलीभूतमपि तत्र व्यदृश्यत॥ ब्रह्मदण्डकृतं सर्वमिति तद् विद्धि पार्थिव।
en: Every blade of grass there was seen to be converted into a terrible iron bolt. All this, know, O king, was due to the curse imprecated by Brahmanas.

sa: पितृभक्तोऽसि राजर्षे मार्कण्डेय इवापरः। तेन मृत्युस्तव वशे स्थितो भृत्य इवानतः॥
en: O royal sage, you are devoted to your father. You are, therefore, like a second Markandeya. It is, therefore, that death depends upon your pleasure like a slave.

sa: श्वेतं ययौ स ततः प्रेक्ष्यमाणो महार्णवो येन महानुभावः॥ सहस्रशीर्षः पर्वताभोगवा रक्ताननः स्वां तनुं तां विमुच्य।।
en: The color of that snake was white. Leaving the human body, that great Naga, of a thousand heads and having a form as large as that of a mountain, endued besides with red eyes, proceeded along the way leading to the ocean.

sa: कथमेष्यति विप्रत्वं कुलं मे भृगुनन्दन। कश्चासौ भविता बन्धुर्मम कश्चापि सम्मतः॥
en: In what way, O delighter of Bhrigu, will the dignity of Brahmanahood attach to my family? Who will be my friend? Who will have my affection and respect?

sa: प्रसुप्ताविव तौ दृष्ट्वा नरसिंहः सुदुःखितः। धनुरुद्यम्य कौन्तेयो व्यलोकयत् तद् वनम्॥
en: And that lion amongst men, beholding them as if buried in slumber, became very afflicted, And then the son of Kunti upraising his bow looked around that forest.

sa: नैताभ्यां भविता दोषः सकाशात्ते पुरंदर। व्येतु ते शक्र संतापस्त्वमेवेन्द्रो भविष्यसि॥
en: O Purandara, by them will no injury be done to you. Let your sorrow cease. O Indra, you will remain as the only one Indra in the world.

sa: गीतं सनत्कुमारेण व्यासेन च महात्मना। एवं स नियतं राजन्नभिगच्छेत् पृथूदकम्॥
en: It has been sung by Sanatkumara and the illustrious Vyasa. O king, it is in the Vedas also, that one should go to the Prithudaka with subdued soul.

sa: उत्तिष्ठ भद्रे गच्छ त्वं ददानीह वरं तव। जनयिष्याम्यपत्यानि त्वय्यहं चारुहासिनि॥
en: The Voice said : O Bhadra, rise up and leave this place. I grant you this boon. O lady of sweet smiles, I shall beget offspring on you.

sa: न तन्मनसि कर्तव्यं पुत्र यद् द्यूतकारितम्। द्रौपद्याश्च परिक्लेशं न चिन्तयितुमर्हसि॥
en: O son, you should not bear in mind the woes inflicted on you on account of the match al dice. You should not remember the sufferings of Draupadi.

sa: तथैव कुरवः सर्वे नाश्मयुद्धविशारदाः। अभिद्रवत माभैष्ट न वः प्राप्स्यति सात्यकिः॥
en: Rush upon Satyaki and fear not for he will not be able to reach you in battle. Thereupon all those mountain kings, all accomplished in fighting with stones.

sa: स धर्मराजो मणिहेमदण्डां जग्राह शक्तिं कनकप्रकाशाम्। नेत्रे च दीप्ते सहसा विवृत्य मद्राधिपं क्रुद्धमना निरैक्षत्॥
en: King Yudhishthira took up a dart whose handle was made of gold and set with gems and which was bright like gold. Rolling his wide open eyes, he looked at the king of Madras, his heart filled with anger.

sa: एष मेघ इवाकाशे वृक्षषण्डः प्रकाशते। मेघसंघातविपुलः पर्यन्तकदलीवृतः॥ किमेतज्ज्ञातुमिच्छामि सखे कौतूहलं मम। कौतूहलापनयनं कर्तुमिच्छाम्यहं त्वया॥
en: These trees skirted by plantain groves, dense as a collection of clouds, appear as clouds in the sky. Great is my curiosity, O friend, to learn what are these. 'And I wish to have my curiosity removed by you.

sa: वसुमना उवाच केन भूतानि वर्धन्ते क्षयं गच्छन्ति केन वा। कमर्चन्तो महाप्राज्ञ सुखमव्ययमाप्नुयुः॥ एवं पृष्टो महाप्राज्ञः कौसल्येनामितौजसा। राजसत्कारमव्यग्रं शशंसास्मै बृहस्पतिः॥
en: Vasumanas said By what means do creatures grow and by what are they destroyed? (you of great wisdom, by worshipping whom do they succeed in acquiring eternal happiness. Thus questioned by the highly powerful Koshala king Brihaspati of great wisdom described to him coolly about the regard which should be paid to kings.

sa: ततो गच्छेत् राजेन्द्र तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम्॥ पृथूदकमिति ख्यातं कार्तिककेयस्य वै नृप। तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वीत पितृदेवार्चने रतः॥
en: O king of kings, one should then go to the Tirtha, celebrated all over the world, which is known by the name of Prithudaka belonging to Kartikeya. O king, by bathing there and worshipping the Pitris and the celestials.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथं स्वर्गे गति: सर्प कर्मणां च फलंध्रुवम्। अशरीरस्य दृश्येत प्रब्रूहि विषयांश्च मे॥
en: (Kindly) tell me O Serpent, how the access of a disembodied being to heaven, how his enjoyment of the rewards and endurance of the punishment consequent on its acts and how its perception through the senses, be conceived. can

sa: पर्यायेण वसतिर्वा भवेषु सर्गे जातः पूर्वमस्मात् कपोतात्। त्वमाददानोऽथ कपोतमेनं मा त्वं राजन् विघ्नकर्ता भवेथाः॥
en: Creatures are not at once born in their own order. You may have been in a former birth begotten by this pigeon. O king, it is not proper for you to interfere with my food by protecting this pigeon.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अजगरचरितं व्रतं महात्मा य इह नरोऽनुचरेद्विनीतरागः। अपगतभयलोभमोहमन्युः स खलु सुखी विचरेदिमं विहारम्॥
en: That great person who, having freed himself from attachments and got rid of fear, cupidity, foolishness, and anger, follows this Ajagara vow, or indulges in this sport, as it may be called, surely spends his time in great happiness.'

sa: अथोतथ्य इति ख्यात आसीद्धीमानृषिः पुरा। ममता नाम तस्यासीद्धार्या परमसंमता॥ उतथ्यस्य यवीयांस्तु पुरोधास्त्रिदिवौकसाम्। बृहस्पतिर्ब्रहत्तेजा ममतामन्वपद्यत॥
en: There was in the time of yore, a wise Rishi, named Utathya. He had a wife, name Mamata whom he dearly loved. One day Utathya's younger brother, the priest of the celestials, the greatly effulgent Brihaspati, proposed to Mamata.

sa: पितामहनियोगाद् वै नान्यथैतद् भविष्यति। तृतीये पुरुषे तुभ्यं ब्राह्मणत्वमुपैष्यति॥ भविता त्वं च सम्बन्धी भृगूणां भावितात्मनाम्।
en: All this will take place at the command of the Grandfather. It will never be otherwise. The status of Brahmanahood will attach to one who is third in descent from you. You shall become a relative of the Bhargavas!

sa: मत्ता गजेन्द्रा मुदिता गवेन्द्रा वनेषु विक्रान्ततरा मृगेन्द्राः। रम्या नगेन्द्रा निभृता नरेन्द्राः प्रकीडिती वारिधरैः सुरेन्द्रः॥
en: (In this season) the elephants are infuriated, the bulls are delighted, the lions have grown more powerful, the hills are charming-the kings are devoid of all active pursuits, are the Lord of celestials is engaged in sport with clouds.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अतिभुक्तं च भवता प्राणेन च विकत्थसे। अनवेक्ष्यं परं पार्थ तेनासि पतित: क्षितौ॥
en: Yudhishthira said You were a great eater, and you used to boast of your strength. You never did attend. O Partha, to the wants of others while eating. It is for that, O Bhima that you have fallen down.

sa: तान् समीपगतानक्षानात्मानं च विवाससम्। पुण्यश्लोकस्तदा राजन् दमयन्तीमथाब्रवीत्॥ येषां प्रकोपादैश्वर्यात् प्रच्युतोऽहमनिन्दिते। प्राणयात्रां न विन्देयं दुःखितः क्षुधयान्वितः॥ येषां कृते न सत्कारमकुर्वन् मयि नैषधाः। इमे ते शकुना भूत्वा वासो भीरु हरन्ति मे॥
en: O king! then Nala of holy fame beholding the dice depart and himself naked, thus spoke of Damayanti. O unblameable lady! they, in consequence of whose wrath I have been deprived of my (royal) fortune and being distressed and oppressed with hunger I cannot procure my livelihood, they through whose (malign) influence the citizens of Naishadha paid me no regard, O timid one! those very dice have assumed the form of birds and are even now fiying away with my cloth.

sa: शूद्रं वैश्यं राजपुत्रं च रार्ज ल्लोकाः सर्वे संश्रिता धर्मकामाः। तस्माद् वर्णाशान्तिधर्मेष्वसक्तान् मत्वा विष्णुर्नेच्छति पाण्डुपुत्र॥
en: Men, desirous of acquiring virtue, seek the help, O king, of Sudras, Vaishyas, and Kshatriyas. If, therefore, the members of these (three) castes do not adopt peaceful duties, Vishnu, O son of Pandu, never extends his favour to them.

sa: दानेन विद्यामभिवाञ्छयामि सत्येनार्थं ब्राह्मणानां च गुप्त्या। शुश्रूषया चापि गुरूनुपैमि न मे भयं विद्यते राक्षसेभ्यः॥
en: By presents I desire to acquire knowledge, and by truth and the protection of Brahmanas. I wish to attain blissful regions of heaven. I always strive to serve my preceptors with my services. I do not fear the Rakshasas.

sa: यादवाः कुकुरा भोजाः सर्वे चान्धकवृष्णयः। त्वय्यासक्ता महाबाहो लोका लोकेश्वराश्च ये॥ उपासते हि त्वबुद्धिमृषयश्चापि माधव।
en: The Yadavas, the Kukuras, the Bhojas, the Andhakas, and the Vrishni, all depend on you even as all the worlds and all the regents of their quarters, O mighty-armed one! The Rishis, O Madhava always pray for your advancement.

sa: श्रीनारायण उवाच त्वत्सम्भूता भूतकृतो वरेण्य गोप्तारोऽस्य भुवनस्यादिदेव। आविश्येमां धरणीं येऽभ्यरक्षन्। पुरा पुराणी तव देवसृष्टिम्॥
en: Narayana said O most adorable one, O first of all the gods, the creators (the Prajapatis) who are protectors of the world and who having entered the earth, your first creation-had, O lord, protected it before, having all sprung

sa: शिष्यः परममेधावी श्रेयोऽर्थी सुसमाहितः। चरणावुपसंगृह्य स्थितः प्राञ्जलिरब्रवीत्॥ उपासनात् प्रसन्नोऽसि यदि वै भगवन् मम। संशयो मे महान् कश्चित् तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि।
en: Once upon a time, a highly intelligent and attentive disciple, desirous of obtaining what was for his highest good touched the preceptor's feet, and standing with joined palms before him, said,-If O illustrious one, you have been pleased with the adoration I have offered you, you should solve a great doubt of mine.

sa: शयामहे वा निहताः पृथिव्यामल्पजीविताः। प्राप्नुयामो ब्रह्मलोकं दुष्प्रापं च कुयोधिभिः॥ अवाप्नुयामः कीर्ति वा निहत्वा शत्रुमाहवे। निहता वीरलोकस्य भोक्ष्यामो वसु वानराः॥
en: We will either lie down on the earth, being slain in consequence of our shortness of days, and thus attain the region of Brahmä incapable of being attained by dastards; or achieve renown by slaying the foe in fight and slain in battle, we shall enjoy the wealth of the region of heroes.

sa: इत्युक्तो देवराजेन मातलिदेवसारथिः। प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं ततो वचनमब्रवीत्।८।। शीघ्रं यास्यामि देवेन्द्र सारथ्यं च करोम्यहम्।
en: Thus accosted by the sovereign of the celestials, Matali-celestial charioteer bending down his head, addressed that celestial saying. Speedily shall I go o lord of the celestials; and I shall also do the office of a charioteer (to Raghava).

sa: न चापश्यच्च सा तत्र कांचिदभ्यागतां सखीम्॥ तस्मिन्काले महातेजाः प्राजापत्यो महानृषिः। स्वाध्यायमकरोत्तत्र तपसा भावितः स्वयम्॥
en: She did not see there any of her associates come to that spot. And at that time that exceedingly energetic and mighty sage, Prajāpati's son, with his soul sanctified through eticism, was engaged in the study of the Veda.

sa: दिव्यानि च सुगन्धीनि माल्यदामानि रावणः। गात्रेषु सज्जयामास श्रोत्रयोश्चास्य कुण्डले॥ काञ्चनाङ्गदकेयूरनिष्काभरणभूषितः। कुम्भकर्णो बृहत्कर्णः सुहृतोऽग्निरिवाबभौ ॥
en: Rāvaņa adorned his person with garlands gorgeous and fragrant, and set ear-rings to his ears. And adorned with golden Angadas and Keyūras and other ornaments of gold, the largeeared Kumbhakarņa appeared like a fire fed full of sacrificial libations.

sa: न त्वेव सीतां परमाभिजातां पथि स्थिते राजकुले प्रजाताम् लतां प्रफुल्लामिव साधुजातां ददर्श तन्वीं मनसाभिजाताम्॥
en: But Hanumān saw not Sītā, of the highest lineage, ever abiding by the way of righteousness; born in a royal line, like to a delightful and well-begot plant, of a slender frame, sprung from the mind (of Brahmä himself);

sa: एतत्सुनीतं मम दर्शनेन रामं हि दृष्टैव भवेदनर्थः। इहैव ते सेत्स्यति मोत्सुको भूर्महानयुद्धेन सुखस्य लाभः॥
en: In my opinion this is the proper course to follow. As soon as you see Rāma, evil shall befall you. Remain here. Do not wish (to go to the field). By refraining from fight, you shall acquire great good.

sa: तस्य सुस्राव रुधिरं पिहिते चास्य लोचने॥ अङ्गदः पाणिना नेत्रे पिधाय रुधिरोक्षिते। सालमासन्नमेकेन परिजग्राह पाणिना। ५२।। संपीड्योरसि सस्कन्धं करेणाभिनिवेश्य च। किंचिदभ्यवनम्यैनमुन्ममाथ महारणे॥ तमिन्द्रकेतुप्रतिमं वृक्षं मन्दरसंनिभम्। समुत्सृजत वेगेन मिषतां सर्वरक्षसाम्॥
en: And blood gushed out of his closed eyes. And then covering his eyes with his hand, Angada with another took a Sala that was hard by. And placing on his breast the Sala furnished with shoulders, and pulling its branches and bending its top, he cleared it of its foliage, in that mighty encounter. Then in the sight of all the Rākşasas he violently discharged that tree resembling the very banner of Indra and appearing like Mandara itself.

sa: स्वैः स्वैः सैन्यैः परिवृता मत्स्यराजानमन्वयुः। तं तु पाटलिपुष्पाणां समवर्णा हयोत्तमाः॥ वहमाना व्यराजन्त मत्स्यस्यामित्रघातिनः। हरिद्रासमवर्णास्तु जवना हेममालिनः॥ पुत्रं विराटराजस्य सत्वरं समुदावहन्। इन्द्रगोपाकवर्णैश्च भ्रातरः पञ्च केकयाः॥
en: Surrounded by their respective forces, followed the king of the Matsyas. Excellent steeds of the colour of trumpet-flowers bearing this latter, appeared very beautiful. Fleet steeds decked with golden chains and resembling turmeric in colour, appeared highly beautiful as they carried the son of that slayer of foes, namely, Virata the royal chief of the Matsya. The five Kekaya brothers were borne by horses of crimson colour.

sa: षट्शतानि सविंशानि श्लोकानां प्राह केशवः। अर्जुन: सप्तपञ्चाशत् सप्तषष्टिं तु संजयः॥ धृतराष्ट्रः श्लोकमेकं गीताया मानमुच्यते।
en: God Krishna has chanted six hundred twenty hymns, Arjuna has chanted fifty seven hymns, Sanjaya has chanted sixty seven and a single hymn has been chanted by Dhritarashtra in this Gita. It is stated the dimension/ expansion of Gita.

sa: तथा गान्धारराजस्य सुतां वीरः स्वयंवरे। निर्जित्य पृथिवीपालानावहत् पुष्करेक्षणः॥ अमृष्यमाणा राजानो यस्य जात्या हया इव। रथे वैवाहिके युक्ताः प्रतोदेन कृतव्रणाः॥
en: That one eyes resembling lotus petals, that most puissant hero, (Krishna), carried away the daughter of the king of the Gandharas, after having defeated, at a Svayamvara (Self-choice) all the rulers of the earth. Like horses, those exasperated kings were harnessed to his bridal chariot and lacerated with the cut of his whip.

sa: तौ च श्रुत्वा मृतौ व्यक्तं पाण्डोः क्षेत्रोद्भवाः सुताः एकाह्ना ससुहृवर्गाः क्लैब्याद्धास्यन्ति जीवितम्।। २ ।
en: Then it is evident also, that hearing of the death of these latter, the other sons of Pandi, with all their allies and friends, will give up their lives in the course of a single day, out of despair.

sa: सुखार्थिनः कुतो विद्या नास्ति विद्यार्थिनः सुखम्। सुखार्थी वा त्येजद् विद्या विद्यार्थी वा त्यजेत् सुखम्।।
en: These seven are ever the defects in those that are striving for knowledge, is my opinion; where is knowledge in those that care for pleasures and there is pleasure for those that care for knowledge. Knowledge should pronounce pleasure.

sa: युधिष्ठिरो राजपुत्रो महात्मा न्यायागतं राज्यमिदं च तस्य। स कौरवस्यास्य कुलस्य भर्ता प्रशासिता चैव महानुभावः॥
en: Yudhishthira is the son of a king and has a great soul; and this kingdom justly goes to him. He being endued with great attributes is the lord of the Kuru race as also the ruler of the kingdom.

sa: सोऽहं न पश्यामि परीक्षमाणः कथं स्वस्ति स्यात् कुरुसुंजयानाम्। आत्तैश्वर्यो धृतराष्ट्रः परेभ्यः प्रवाजिते विदुरे दीर्घदृष्टो॥
en: Therefore even when I consider, do I not see how it can go well with the Kurus and the Srinjayas, Dhritarashtra having usurped the wealth of others and the far seeing Vidura having been banished to a foreign country.

sa: करोति विश्वम्। धृतराष्ट्र उवाच येऽस्मिन्धर्मान् नाचरन्तीह केचित् तथा धर्मान् केचिदिहाचरन्ति। दुताहो धर्मः प्रतिहन्ति पापम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Some there are in this world who practice virtue and some that do not practice virtue but renounce all sorts of actions. (Regarding the former I ask) Is virtue destroyed by unrighteousness or does righteousness destroy virtue?

sa: न मे विषेषो जात्वासीत् धार्तराष्ट्रेषु पाण्डवैः तेन सत्येन कृष्ण त्वां हतामित्रं श्रिया वृतम्। अस्माद् विमुक्तं संग्रामात् पश्येयं पाण्डवैः सह॥६शा
en: I never treated the sons of Dhritarashtra in a different way from that in which I treated the sons of Pandu; and by virtue of this truth shall I see, O Krishna, yourself along with the Pandavas after you have slain your enemies invested with prosperity, come out safe from this impending war.

sa: तत्र राजा धृतराष्ट्रः सपुत्रो धन॑ हरेत् पाण्डवानामकस्मात्। नावेक्षन्ते राजधर्मं पुराणं तदन्वयाः कुरवः सर्व एव॥
en: The king Dhritarashtra with his sons all on a sudden robbed the sons of Pandu of their just inheritance and thus has set at naught the duties observed by kings from times immemorial. And all the Kurus follow him.

sa: त एवमुक्ताः प्रत्यूचू राजानमरिमर्दनम्॥ या गतिस्तव राजेन्द्र सास्माकमपि भारत। कथं वा सम्प्रवेक्ष्यामस्त्वविहीनाः पुरं वयम्॥
en: Having been thus addressed by him, they thus replied to that royal chastiser of foes, “O king of kings, O descendant of Bharata, the course that is yours is also ours. How can we enter the city without you?”

sa: न विश्वासाज्जातु परस्य गेहे गच्छेन्नरशेतयानो विकाले। न चत्वरे निशि तिष्ठेन्निगूढो न राजकाम्यां योषितं प्रार्थयीत॥
en: A man should not, out of confidence, go to the house of an untrustworthy person in the evening. He should not hide himself in the yard of another's house at night, nor desire a woman sued by a king.

sa: सोऽन्तर्हितः पुनस्तस्य दर्शनं राक्षसो व्रजन्॥ चकर्ष महदध्वानं रामस्तं बुबुधे ततः। निशाचरं विदित्वा तं राघवः प्रतिभानवान्॥ अमोघं शरमादाय जघान मृगरूपिणम्।
en: And that Rakshasa now appearing before him and then disappearing from his view. Allured Rama to a great distance. Rama, then, knew what that deer really was. The intelligent Raghava knowing him to be a Rakshasa, took up an arrow of infallible energy and killed him who wore the shape of a deer.

sa: अव्याधिजं कटुकं शीर्षरोगि पापानुबन्धं परुषं तीक्ष्णमुष्णम्। सतां पेयं यन्न पिबन्त्यसन्तो मन्यु महाराज पिब प्रशाम्य॥
en: Anger is a drink which the unrighteous cannot swallow. It brings on pain in the end, which is bitter, pungent and hot. It ought to be swallowed up by the good. You, great king, swallow it and be pacified.

sa: सुपर्ण उवाच इयं दिग् दयिता राज्ञो वरुणस्य तु गोपतेः। सदा सलिलराज्य प्रतिष्ठा चादिरेव च।।।।
en: Suparna said This direction is the favorite one of king Varuna, the lord of the seas. In fact this has been the region of the birth of the king of the waters and even the region of his influence.

sa: पुनरेव माहाबहुरपर्वां तनुमाश्रितः। नरस्य कृत्वार्धतर्नु सिंहस्यार्धतर्नु प्रभुः॥ दैत्येन्द्रस्य सभां गत्वा पाणिं संस्पृश्य पाणिना। दैत्यानामादिपुरुषः सुरारिदितिनन्दनः॥ दृष्ट्वा चापूर्वपुरुषं क्रोधात् संरक्तलोचनः।
en: Again assuming a wonderful form, half-lion, half-man, the mighty armed Lord, squeezing his hand, went to the court of the king of Daityas. The first man of the Daitya race, the enemy of the celestials, the son of Diti, beholding this wonderful form, became worked up with anger and his eyes became red.

sa: वास एव यथा त्यक्तं प्रावृण्वानोऽभिमन्यसे। स्रजं त्यक्तामिव प्राप्य लोभाद् यौधिष्ठिरीं श्रियम्॥ द्रौपदीसहितं पार्थं सायुधैर्धातृभिर्वृतम्।
en: Putting on as it were cast off clothes you have taken on yourself the cast off prosperity of Yudhishthira and think it to be your own. The son of Pritha in company with Draupadi and surrounded by his brothers,

sa: तां संहृष्टः पाण्डुरुवाच इयं ते सपल्यनपत्या; साध्वस्या अपत्यमुत्पाद्यतामिति। एवमस्त्विति कुन्ती तां विद्यां मात्र्याः प्रायच्छत्॥
en: Pandu was much pleased with her and said, “This your sister (my co-wife) is also childless. Therefore, cause her to give birth to children.” Kunti said, “Let it be so," and she imparted unto Madri the Mantra of invocation.

sa: विद्धं तु लक्ष्यं प्रसमीक्ष्य कृष्णा पार्थं च शक्रप्रतिमं निरीक्ष्य। आदाय शुक्लं वरमाल्यदाम जगाम कुन्तीसुतमुत्स्मयन्ती॥
en: Seeing the mark shot and seeing also Partha who had shot the mark like Indra himself, Krishna (Draupadi) was filled with joy; and she came to the son of Kunti with a white robe and a garland of flowers.

sa: न मे विशेष: पुत्रेषु स्वेषु पाण्डुसुतेषु वा। वृद्ध मामभ्यसूयन्ति पुत्रा मन्युपरायणाः॥ अहं त्वचक्षुः कार्पण्यात्पुत्रप्रीत्या सहामि तत्। मुह्यन्तं चानुमुह्यामि दुर्योधनमचेतनम्॥
en: I felt no difference between my sons and the sons of Pandu. My own sons were wayward and they hated me, because I was old and blind. I bore all on account of my miserable state of being blind and for paternal affection. I was foolish and thoughtless and Duryodhana grew in folly.

sa: त्रिवर्षकृतयज्ञस्तु गन्धर्वाणामुपप्लवे। अर्जुनप्रमुखैः पार्थैः सौवीरः समरे हतः॥ न शशाक वशे कर्तुं यं पाण्डुरपि वीर्यवान्। सोऽर्जुनेन वशं नीतो राजाऽऽसीद् यवनाधिपः॥
en: Arjuna and the other Pandava princes became so powerful that they killed in battle the great Sauvira who had performed a sacrifice extending for three years, (remaining) undaunted by the attacks of the Gandharvas. The Yavana king, whom the powerful Pandu could not bring under subjection, was (also brought by Arjuna under control.

sa: तं संकल्पं विदित्वाग्नेत्विा पुत्रांश्च बालकान्। सोऽभितुष्टाव विप्रर्षिाह्मणो जातवेदसम्॥ पुत्रान् प्रति वदन् भीतो लोकपालं महौजसम्।
en: Knowing the intention of Agni and remembering also that his children were all young, moved by fear, he gratified Agni, the greatly effulgent regent of the universe. He did it, wishing to say a word for his unfledged offspring.

sa: समयेन च कर्ताहमनेन विधिपूर्वकम्। यथा यधुपलप्स्यामि करिष्ये नान्यथा ह्यहम्॥ सनाम्नी या भवित्री मे दित्सिता चैव बन्धुभिः। भैक्ष्यवत्तामहं कन्यामुपयंस्ये विधानतः॥
en: If a bride can be had whose name will be the same as mine, whose friends will give her to me willingly and as a gift, O fathers, under these conditions, if I get a girl, your command will be obeyed. I shall duly marry her according to the ordinances of the Shastras.

sa: यथाहं विमृशाम्येकस्तत् तावच्छूयतां मम। संन्यासं रोचये साधु कार्यस्यास्य जनार्दन। प्रतिहन्ति मनो मेऽद्य राजसूयो दुराहरः॥
en: O Jarasandha, O excellent man, listen to what I think. To desist from this act seems to be beneficial to me. My heart is full of misery to-day. The Rajasuya sacrifice seems to me very difficult to be accomplished.

sa: इति कथयति रामे चन्द्रतुल्याननेन प्रविरलतरतारं व्योम जज्ञे तदानीम्। अरुणकिरणरक्ता दिग्बभौ चैव पूर्वा कुसुमरसविमुक्तं वस्त्रमागुण्ठितेव॥
en: While Rāma, having moon-like countenance, was speaking thus, the stars became fewer in the welkin, and east, stricken with the early rays of the sun, appeared like a damsel, clothed in a raiment coloured with the dye of flowers.

sa: आप्तैरलुब्धैः क्रमिकैस्ते च कच्चिदनुष्ठिताः। कच्चिद् राजन् कृतान्येव कृतप्रायाणि वा पुनः॥३३। विदुस्ते वीर कर्माणि नानवाप्तानि कानिचित्। कच्चित् कारणिका धर्मे सर्वशास्त्रेषु कोविदाः। कारयन्ति कुमारांश्च योधमुख्यांश्च सर्वशः॥
en: O king, do you accomplish your works by men that are trusted and incorruptible and that possess of practical experience? O hero, people surely know only the measures that have been accomplished or partially accomplished, and surely they can not know those that are, merely in contemplation. Have you appointed teachers, learned in all the Shastras and religious precepts, for the princes and for the chief warriors?

sa: कारयन्तु च कुल्यानि शुभानि च बृहन्ति च। ये च तत्र मृतास्तेषां सुहृदो यान्तु तानपि॥
en: Let also the bones of the deceased be sanctified by the usual rites and let all the beneficial and great acts be performed. Let the friends and relatives of those that have been burnt to death also go there.

sa: ते तत्र भुक्त्वा पुरुषवीरा यथाऽऽत्मकामं सुभृशं प्रतीताः। उत्क्रम्य सर्वाणि वसूनि राजन् सांग्रामिकं ते विविशुनूवीराः॥
en: Then those foremost of men dined on those dishes and became well pleased. After the dinner was over, those heroes among men, passing over, all other things, began to examine with interest the various implements of war (displayed there).

sa: भीष्मकस्य कुले साध्वी रुक्मिणी नाम नामतः॥१५६। द्रौपदी त्वथ संजज्ञे शचीभागादनिन्दिता। द्रुपदस्य कुले कन्या वेदिमध्यादनिन्दिता॥
en: She was born in the race of Bhishmaka and that illustrious lady was named Rukmini. Draupadi was born from a portion of Sachi, (the wife of Indra) in the race of Drupada and from the altar of the sacrifice.

sa: सान्त्व्यमाना तु रामेण मैथिली जनकात्मजा। वनवासनिमित्तार्थं भर्तारमिदमब्रवीत्॥ सा तमुत्तमसंविग्ना सीता विपुलवक्षसम्। प्रणयाच्चाभिमानाच्च परिचिक्षेप राघवम्॥
en: Being consoled thus by Rāma, Maithilī, the daughter of Janaka, fearing separation, lovingly and haughtily laughed at Rāghava of spacious breast, and spoke to him, her husband, the following words with a view to follow him to the forest.

sa: सुधामणिविचित्राणि भूमिभागानि सर्वशः। दशग्रीवः स्वभवने प्रादर्शयत मैथिलीम्॥ दीर्घिकाः पुष्करिण्यश्च नानापुप्पसमावृताः। रावणो दर्शयामास सीतां शोकपरायणाम्॥
en: The ground all over was decorated with ambrosia and gems. The Ten-headed one in his own mansion showed to Maithilī large tanks and pools covered with various kinds of flowers. (All this) Rāvaņa showed to Sítā overmastered by sorrow.

sa: नखदंष्ट्रायुधाः सर्वे वीरा विकृतदर्शनाः। सर्वे शार्दूलदंष्ट्राश्च सर्वे विवृतदर्शनाः॥ दशनागबलाः केचित् केचिद् दशगुणोचराः। केचिनागसहस्रस्य बभूवुस्तुल्यवर्चसः॥
en: Some of them had sharpened teeth and nails, some were grim-visaged, some had teeth like those of tigers, some had the strength of ten elephants, some had the strength of hundred elephants and some had that of thousand elephants.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा सुमित्रां तां विवर्णवदना कृशा। प्रतस्थे भरतो यत्र वेपमाना विचेतना॥ स तु राजात्मजश्चापि शत्रुघ्नसहितस्तदा। प्रतस्थे भरतो येन कौसल्याया निवेशनम्॥
en: Having said this to Sumitrā, that one emaciated and with a pallid countenance, trembling and almost deprived of sensation, went to where Bharata, was. And it came to pass that the king's son, Bharata, along with Śatrughna had just then by the way that led to the same, been proceeding to Kausalyā's quarter.

sa: नाहं शतसहस्रेण नापि कोटिशतैर्गवाम्॥ राजन् दास्यामि शबलां राशिभी रजतस्य वा। न परित्यागमयं मत्सकाशादरिंदम ॥
en: O king, neither for an hundred thousand nor for an hundred Koți of kine, nor yet for heaps of silver, will I part with Sabala. O subduer of enemies, this one deserves not to be separated from my side.

sa: राजा कृत्स्नस्य जगत इक्ष्वाकूणां महारथः। रामो दाशरथिः श्रीमान् प्रविष्टो दण्डकावनम्॥ लक्ष्मणेन. सह भ्रात्रा वैदेह्या सह भार्यया। पितुर्निदेशनिरतो धर्मं पन्थानमाश्रितः॥
en: It came to pass that mighty monarch of all this earth, descendant of the Ikṣwākus, the great and graceful car warrior, Rāma, son to Dasaratha, intent upon the injunction of his sire, resorting to the path of righteousness, entered the woods of Dandaka in company with his brother, Lakşmaņa and his wife Vaidehī.

sa: त्वं हि वायुसुतो वत्स प्लवने चापि तत्समः॥ वयमद्य गतप्राणा भवानस्मासु साम्प्रतम्। दाक्ष्यविक्रमसम्पन्नः कपिराज इवापरः॥
en: The are the son of the Wind, my child-equal to him in power of leaping. Now we are without our lives. And you, endowed with dexterity and vigour, and like another I of the monkeys,+ are before us. *Sugriva.

sa: शूरमानीं न शूरस्त्वं मिथ्यारोपितविक्रमः॥ अपयाहि जनस्थानात् त्वरितः सहबान्धवः। जहि त्वं समरे मूढान्यथा तु कुलपांसन॥ मानुषौ तौ न शक्नोसि हन्तुं वै रामलक्ष्मणौ। निःसत्त्वस्याल्पवीर्यस्य वासस्ते कीदृशस्त्विह॥
en: You plume yourself on being a hero; but are really none such. Prowess has been falsely attributed to you. Go off from Janasthāna without delay, along with your friends. O stainer of your line, do you in battle slay those foolhardy ones. But if you fail in slaying those human beings, Rama and Laksmana, then how can you void of strength and of slender prowess, stay here?

sa: तथोक्त्वा राक्षसीस्तास्तु राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान्॥ निष्क्रम्यान्तः पुरात् तस्मात् किं कृत्यमिति चिन्तयन्। ददर्शाष्टौ महावीर्यान् राक्षसान् पिशिताशनान्॥
en: Heaving said this to the Rākşasis, the puissant lord of the Rākṣasas, went out of the inner apartment, and thought within himself as to what was to be done (next). And he saw eight flesheating Rākşasas of wondrous prowess.

sa: ततो यमौ दुपदविराटकेकया युधिष्ठिरश्चापि परां मुदं ययुः। वृकोदरं भृशमनुपूजयंश्च ते यथान्धके प्रतिनिहते हरं सुराः॥
en: Then the twins (i.e., Nakula and Sahadeva), Drupada, Virata and the Kekayas as well as Yudhishthira experienced a great joy and paid high complements to Vrikodara as the celestials paid to Hara after the slaughter of Andhaka by him.

sa: तस्माद् बिभेमि बलवद् ब्राह्मणव्याहतादहम्। एते हि सोमराजान ईश्वराः सुखदुःखयो॥ अदां तस्मै गोसहस्रं बलीवर्दाश्च षट्शतान्। प्रसादं न लभे शल्य ब्राह्मणान्मद्रकेश्वर॥
en: I always stand in great fear of these words of the Brahmana. The kings of the Lunar dynasty, the lords of people's happiness and on COW as misery, offered him a thousand kine and six hundred bovine bulls. Still with such a gift O Shalya, O king Madra, the Brahmana was not grated.

sa: तव पुत्रेण संग्रामे विदुद्राव नराधिप। तं तपन्तमिवादित्यं कुरुराज महाहवे॥ नाशकन् वीक्षितुं राजन् पाण्डुपुत्रस्य सैनिकाः। ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा कुपितो राजसत्तम॥
en: o king! The soldiers in the army of Pandavas could not even put an eye on Duryodhana, the Kuru king who was glowing like a son in that great battle. O great king! King Yudhishthira then rushed fast with an intention to kill your son, the king of Kuru, Duryodhana in furious mood.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो रणे तेन द्रोणपुत्रेण भारत॥ गाण्डीवधन्वा प्रसभं शरवर्षेरुदारधीः। संछाद्य समरे द्रौणिं चिच्छेदास्य च कार्मुकम्॥
en: O son of Bharata being greatly wounded in battle by that son of Drona he, with force, took up his Gandiva bow. Then the highly intelligent hero covered Drona's son with a downpour of arrows and cut-off his bowstring.

sa: एवमादिगुणानां ते कर्मणां दिवि चेह च। अतीतभूतभव्यानां संख्यातात्र न विद्यते॥ सर्वतो रक्षणीयाः स्म शक्रेणेव दिवौकसः। यैस्त्वं सर्वगुणोपेतः सुहन्न उपपादितः॥
en: Nobody either on this or heaven is capable to make a record of the acts executed in past, present and future and to calculate yours such qualities (gunas). All of us are always defendable by you as lord Indra provides the gods with proper defence. We have got you as a meritorious friend.

sa: घटोत्कचेन वीरेण हतः शालकटङ्कटः। ततः सुमनसः पार्था हते तस्मिन् निशाचरे॥ चुक्रुशुः सिंहनादांश्च वासांस्यादुधुवुश्च ह। तावकाश्च हतं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसेन्द्रं महाबलम्॥
