en: And slain by the heroic Ghatotkacha the Rakshasa Alambusha looked like a Sala tree broken and uprooted by the wind. Upon the slaughter of that ranger ranger of the night (Alambusha), the Parthas, filled with delight, Uttered loud roars and waived their garments in the air. Beholding that mighty foremost the Rakshasas slain.

sa: संजय उवाच तथा तु वैकर्तनपीडितं तं भीमं प्रयान्तं पुरुषप्रवीरम् समीक्ष्य राजन् नरवीरमध्ये शिनिप्रवीरोऽनुययौ रथेन।॥
en: Sanjaya said Seeing that foremost of men namely Bhima, proceed, although pierced with the arrows of Vikartana's son in the midst of so many heroes, O monarch, that excellent warrior of the Sini race, followed him on his chariot.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तदा तेन पाण्डवेन महात्मना। जयेन सम्पूज्य स पाण्डवं तदा। प्रचोदयामास हयान् मनोजवान् स पाण्डुपुत्रस्य रथो मनोजवः क्षणेन कर्णस्य रथागतोऽभवत्॥
en: Thus addressed by the noble son of Pandu Kesava who wishes him victory lashed the steeds which were swift as the mind and very quickly brought the car of Pandu's son before Karna's chariot. steeds which were swift as the mind and very quickly brought the car of Pandu's son before Karna's chariot.

sa: सर्वस्वस्यापहारे तु वक्तव्यमनृतं भवेत्। तत्रानृतं भवेत् सत्यं चाप्यनृतं भवेत्॥ तादृशं पश्यते बालो यस्य सत्यमनुष्ठितम्।
en: Where one's entire fortunes are at stake untruth becomes utterable. On these occasions untruth becomes truth and truth untruth. He who is bent upon always practising truth alone is a fool and takes truth to be as it is.

sa: ग्राम्यवाराहमांसं च यच्चैवाप्रोक्षितं भवेत्। कृष्णाजाजी विडश्चैव शीतपाकी तथैव च। अङ्कुराधास्तथा वा इह शृङ्गाटकानि च॥ वर्जयेल्लवणं सर्वं तथा जम्बूफलानि च। अवक्षुतावरुदितं तथा श्राद्धे च वर्जयेत्॥
en: The other articles that should not be offered at Shraddhas are the flesh of the domesticated hog, the meat of all animals not killed at sacrifices, Nigella sativa, salt of the variety called Vid, the potherb that is called Shitapaki, all sprouts and also the Trapa bispinosa. All kinds of salt should be excluded from the offerings made at Shraddhas, and also fruits of the Eugenia Jambolana.

sa: तमुवाच प्रसन्नात्मा गोविन्दो जनमेजय। वरं वृणीष्वेति तदा तमुत्तङ्कोऽब्रवीदिदम्॥ पर्याप्त एष एवाद्य परस्त्वत्तो महाद्युते। यत् ते रूपमिदं कृष्णं पश्यामि पुरुषोत्तम॥
en: To him, O Janaimejaya, Govinda of contented spirit said these words, Do you ask for some boon! To him Utanka, however said this is a sufficient boon from you for the present, O you of great splendour, in that, O Krishna, I have seen this form of yours, O foremost of all beings!

sa: वासुदेव उवाच मातरं सर्वभूतानां पृच्छे त्वां संशयं शुभे। केनस्वित् कर्मणा पापं व्यपोहति नरो गृही॥
en: Vasudeva said O mother, of all creatures, O auspicious goddess, I wish to ask you for a solution of this doubt of mine! By what act does a man living like a householder succeed in cleansing all his sins.?

sa: ब्राह्मणा: ऊचु: कपान्वयं विजेष्यामो ये देवास्ते वयं स्मृताः। तस्माद् वध्याः कपाऽस्माकं धनिन् याहि यथाऽऽगतम्।।
en: The Brahmanas said Oh, we shail subjugate the Kapas. In this matter, we are quite of a piece with the celestials. Hence, the Kapas deserve to be killed by us. As regards Dhanin, he should return whence he came.

sa: अहिंसन् ब्राह्मणस्वानि न्यायेन परिपाल्य च। क्षत्रियस्तरसा प्राप्तमन्नं यो वै प्रयच्छति॥ द्विजेभ्यो वेदवृद्धेभ्यः प्रयत: सुसमाहितः। तेनोपोहति धर्मात्मन् दुष्कृतं कर्म पाण्डव॥
en: That Kshatriya who, without taking anything belonging to a Brahmana, protects his subjects lawfully, and makes gifts of food, obtained by his strength. to Brahmanas foremost in Vedic knowledge, with concentrated heart, succeeds by such conduci, O you of righteous soul in cleansing himself, O son of Pandu, of all his sinful deeds.

sa: सम्यग् यजन्ति ये चेष्टीः क्षान्ता दान्ता जितेन्द्रियाः। सत्यं धर्मे क्षितिं गाश्च तान् नमस्यामि यादव।॥
en: I adore them, O Yadava, who are performers of sacrifices, who are forgiving in nature, and selfcontrolled, who are masters of their own senses, who worship truth and virtue, and who give away land and kine to good Brahmanas.

sa: प्रियो हि मे ब्राह्मणो याचमानो दद्यामहं वोऽश्वतरीसहस्रम्। एकैकशः सवृषाः सम्प्रसूताः सर्वेषां वै शीघ्रगाः श्वेतरोमाः॥
en: That Brahmana who solicits me is ever dear to me. Indeed I shall give you a thousand kine of white hair, foremost in speed, each accompanied by a bull, and each having a wellborn calf, and, therefore, giving milk.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तेऽनुज्ञातास्तदा राजन् कुरुराजेन पाण्डवाः। विविधान्यन्नपानानि विश्राम्यानुभवन्ति ते॥ मासमेकं विजह्वस्ते ससैन्यान्तःपुरा वने। अथ तत्रागमद् व्यासो यथोक्तं ते मयाऽनघ॥
en: Vaishampayana said With the permission of the Kuru king, the Pandavas, O monarch, with their troops and the ladies of their household, lived on various kinds of food and drink and passed about a month in great happiness in that forest. Towards the close of that period, O sinless one, Vyasa came there.

sa: स शोकं जहि दुर्धर्ष मा च मन्युवशं गमः॥ शस्त्रपूतां हि स गतिं गतः परपुरंजयः।
en: O irresistible one, do you kill this grief of thine! Do not allow yourself to be swayed by anger. That conqueror of hostile cities has attained to that sanctified and which depends upon death at the edge of weapons.

sa: प्रतिलोमप्रसूतानां वर्णानां चैव यः स्मृतः॥ देशजातिकुलानां न जानीषे धर्मलक्षणम्। वेदोक्तो यश्च शिष्टोक्तः सदैव विदितस्तव॥
en: The duties that have been laid down for the issues of intermarriages and those laid down for particular countries and tribes and families, and those declared by the Vedas and the wise men, are all well known to you.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच किं पार्थिवेन कर्तव्यं किं च कृत्वा सुखी भवेत्। एतदाचक्ष्व तत्त्वेन सर्वधर्मभृतां वर॥
en: Yudhishthira said What works should be done by a king, and what are those works by doing which a king may become happy? Tell me this fully, O you who are the foremost of all persons acquainted with duties.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच वेदाहं तात शास्त्राणि अपराणि पराणि च। उभयं वेदवचनं कुरु कर्म त्यजेति च॥
en: Yudhishthira said I know both the Vedas and the scriptures that lead to the attainment of Brahma. In the Vedas there are both kinds of precepts, viz., those that preach action and those that preach the renouncement of action,

sa: नकुलं सारथिं कृत्वा द्रोणपुत्रवधे धृतः॥ विस्फार्य सशरं चापं तूर्णमश्वानचोदयत्। ते हयाः पुरुषव्याघ्र चोदिता वातरंहसः॥
en: Making Nakula his. chariotecr, and determined upon killing the son of Drona, he began to draw his bow and made his horses to be urged without delay. Those horses, flect as the wind, urged, run at a furious speed.

sa: स बुद्ध्वा तस्य राष्ट्रस्य व्यवसायं हि सर्वशः। राजयुक्तापहारांश्च सर्वान् बुद्ध्वा ततस्ततः॥ ततः स काकमादाय राजानं द्रष्टुमागमत्। सर्वज्ञोऽस्मीति वचनं ब्रुवाणः संशितव्रतः॥ स स्म कौसल्यमागम्य राजामात्यमलंकृतम्। प्राह काकस्य वचनादमुत्रेदं त्वया कृतम्॥ असौ चासौ च जानीते राजकोशस्त्वया हतः। एवमाख्याति काकोऽयं तच्छीघ्रमनुगम्यताम्॥
en: Having ascertained all the affairs of the state, and having learnt that all the officers, appointed by the king were guilty of misdeeds, the sage, with his crow, came to see the king. Of rigid vows, he said to the king,-I know everything. Coming to the king, he said to his minister holding the insignia of his office that he had been informed by his crow that the minister had done such a crime in such a place, and that such and such persons know that he had robbed the royal treasury! My crow tells me this. Admit or prove the falsehood of the charge speedily.

sa: उपाशाम्यत् ततस्तीवं तद् रजो घोरदर्शनम्। ततोऽपश्यमहं भूयो द्वन्द्वयुद्धानि भारत॥ यथाप्राणं यथाश्रेष्ठं मध्याह्ने वै सुदारुणे। वर्मणां तत्र राजेन्द्र व्यदृश्यन्तोज्ज्वला: प्रभाः॥
en: When that dense and awful cloud of dust was put down there were seen many single encounters, O Bharata, that the heroes fought at the noon each according to his strength and his rank. They were all exceedingly fierce. The sheen of the weapons in those encounters, O king, appeared full in view.

sa: ततस्ते त्वरिता राजंस्त्यक्त्वा शोकं शिशूद्भवम्॥ विविशुः पुत्रमादाय नगरं हृष्टमानसाः। एषा बुद्धिः समस्तानां चातुर्वण्र्ये निदर्शिता॥
en: Then, O king, shaking off that grief caused by their child, those Brahmanas, filled with joy, quickly returned to their town; taking the restored child with them. Such a conduct has been laid down for all the four castes.

sa: यथा च नावं कौन्तेय कर्णधारः समाहितः। महार्णवगतां शीघ्रं नयेत् पार्थिवसत्तम॥ तद्वदात्मसमाधानं युक्त्वा योगेन तत्त्ववित्। दुर्गमं स्थानमाप्नोति हित्वा देहमिमं नृप॥
en: As a boat, O son of Kunti, who is tossed on the bosom of the sea is very soon taken by a careful boatman to the other shore, so the man of knowledge by fixing his soul in concentration, acquires Liberation, which is so difficult to acquire, after renouncing his body, O king.

sa: पश्चादस्याभवद् राजन्नात्मनः साध्वसं महत्। यद् गत्वा दूरमध्वानं क्षेमी पुनरिहागतः॥ मेरोः प्रचक्राम ततः पर्वतं गन्धमादनम्।
en: And he said to himself,-'How wonderful is it! The journey I have done is a long one! Having gone to such a distance, I have returned safe and sound!' From the mountains of Meru he then went towards Gandhamadana.

sa: प्राविशद् भवनं स्वं वै गृहीत्वा तं द्विजोत्तमम्। आसनं स्वं ददौ चैव पाद्यमर्थ्य तथैव च॥
en: Having said these words, Kubera took the hand of that foremost of Brahmanas and conducted him into his palace. He offered him his own seat as also water to wash his feet and the present of the usual ingredients.

sa: कुटीकृतं तथैवात्र कमलाभं सहस्रशः। श्लक्ष्णं वस्त्रमकार्पासमाविकं मृदु चाजिनम्॥ निशितांश्चैव दीर्घासीनृष्टिशक्तिपरश्वधान्। अपरान्तसमुद्भूतांस्तथैव परशूञ्छितान्॥ रसान् गन्धांश्च विविधान् रत्नानि च सहस्रशः। बलिं च कृत्स्नमादाय द्वारि तिष्ठन्ति वारिताः॥
en: They also gave thousands of other cloths not made of cotton and all possessing the colour of the lotus, being made of smooth and soft texture. They also gave thousands of soft sheepskins, also many sharp and long swords and scimitars, hatches and fine-edged battleaxes, manufactured in the western countries also thousands of perfumes, jewels and gems. But being refused admittance they all waited at the gate.

sa: अस्मिन् क्रतौ यथोक्तानि यज्ञाङ्गानि द्विजातिभिः। तथोपकरणं सर्वं मङ्गलानि च सर्वशः॥ अधियज्ञांश्च सम्भारान् धौम्योक्तान् क्षिप्रमेव हि। समानयन्तु पुरुषा यथायोगं यथाक्रमम्॥
en: “Let men be appointed to collect without loss of time all those articles which the Brahmanas will direct as necessary for the performance of this sacrifice, and also all auspicious necessaries and things that Dhaumya may order to be collected; each of the king required and one after the other in due order.

sa: यदर्थे पुरुषव्याघ्र कीर्तयन्ति पुरातनाः। एष्टव्या बहवः पुत्रा योकोऽपि गयां व्रजेत्॥ यजेत वाश्वमेधेन नीलं वा वृषमुत्सृजेत्। उत्तारयति संतत्या दशपूर्वान् दशावरान्॥
en: O foremost of men, it is for this reason the ancients say that inen should desire for many sons, so that one (son) at least among them may go to Gaya. May perform the horsesacrifice and may give away a Nila bull and thus deliver ten generations of his race upwards and downwards.

sa: त्वामेकं कारणं कृत्वा कालेन भरतर्षभ। समेतं पार्थिवं क्षत्रं क्षयं यास्यति भारत। दुर्योधनापराधेन भीमार्जुनबलेन च॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, O descendant of Bharata, in course of time, making you the sole cause, the assembled Kshatriya kings will all be destroyed for the fault of Duryodhana and the prowess of Bhima and Arjuna.

sa: जिते हिधर्मस्य सुते सभार्य सभ्रातृके सानुचरे निरस्ते। दुर्योधने चापि विवर्धमाने कथं न सीदत्यवनिः सशैला।॥
en: Why did not the earth sink with all these hills when the son of Dharma met with defeat and when his wife, brothers, followers and he himself, were driven away (from the kingdom) and when Duryodhana began to flourish.

sa: नदी समङ्गा च बभूव पुण्या यस्यां स्नातो मुच्यते किल्बिषाद्धिा त्वमप्येनां स्नानपानावगाहैः सभ्रातृकः सहभार्यो विशस्व॥
en: From that day that river became known by the name of Samanga and it became capable of cleansing sins. He who bathes in it is cleansed of all sins. Therefore enter with your brothers and wife into its water.

sa: कच्चिद्धौम्यस्त्वदाचारैर्न पार्थ परितप्यते। दानधर्मतप:शौचैरार्जवेन तितिक्षया॥ पितृपैतामहं वृत्तं कच्चित् पार्थानुवर्तसे। कच्चिद् राजर्षियातेन पथा गच्छसि पाण्डव॥
en: O Partha, are not Dhaumya pained by your treatment of him? Do you follow in the footsteps of your forefathers by practicing charity, religious observances, devotion, purity, candour and forgiveness? Do you follow the example of the royal sages?

sa: स हंसः सम्प्रमत्तानामप्रमत्तः स्वकर्मणि। ततः प्रक्षीयमाणेषु तेषु तेष्वण्डजोऽपरः। अशङ्कत महाप्राज्ञः स कदाचिद् ददर्श ह॥
en: That swan, always attentive to his own purpose, ate the eggs foolishly trusted to him, Some time after seeing the eggs decreased in number, another greatly intelligent bird suspected him, and one day he saw him (eat those eggs).

sa: ततो गच्छेतधर्मज्ञ नमस्कृत्य महागिरिम्॥ स्वर्गद्वारेण यत् तुल्यं गङ्गाद्वारं न संशयः। तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वीत कोटितीर्थे समाहितः॥
en: O virtuous one, one should then go, after bowing to the great mountain. To the source of the Ganges which is certainly like the gate of heaven. There one should with controlled soul bathe in the Tirtha called Koti.

sa: अष्टावक्र उवाच अष्टौ शाणाः शतमानं वहन्ति तथाष्टपादः शरभः सिंहघाती। अष्टौ वसूशुश्रुम देवतासु यूपश्चाष्टास्त्रिर्विहितः सर्वयज्ञे।॥
en: Ashtavakra said: Eight are the bags that hold hundred-fold, eight is the number of the Sarava, which preys upon lions, eight are the Vasus among the celestials and eight are the angles of a Yupa (stake) in a sacrifice.

sa: एषैव बुद्धिर्जुषतां सदा त्वां सत्ये स्थिताः केशव पाण्डवेयाः। सदानधर्माः सजनाः सदारा: सबान्धवास्त्वच्छरणा हि पार्थाः॥
en: May this intention of yours, always remain in you. For O Keshava, the Parthas, the sons of Pandu, firmn in truth and devoted to charity and duty, together with their friends, relations and their wives (always) under your protection."

sa: उपालब्धः शिष्यमध्ये महर्षिः स तं कोपादुदरस्थं शशाप। यस्मात् कुक्षौ वर्तमानो ब्रवीषि तस्माद् वक्रो भवितास्यष्टकृत्वः॥
en: Through your grace I have become even in my this fatal state learned in all the Shastras and in the Vedas and in the Vedangas. But O father, I tell you what proceeds from your lips is not correct."

sa: निमेषान्तरमात्रेण भारद्वाजोऽपरं धनुः॥ सज्यं चकार तदपि चिच्छेदास्य च सात्यकिः। ततस्त्वरन् पुनर्दोणो धनुर्हस्तो व्यतिष्ठत॥ सज्यं सज्यं धनुश्चास्य चिच्छेद निशितैः शरैः।
en: But in a wink's time, the son of Bharadvaja fixed the string on another bow; but that also Satyaki cut-off quickly. But again Drona stood ready with a bow in hand. As often however Drona strung his bow so often did Satyaki cut it off and this he did for full sixty-three times.

sa: ततः कराग्रैः सहसा समेत्य राजा हरीणाममरेन्द्रशत्रोः। खरैश्च कर्णौ दशनैश्च नासां ददंश पादैविददार पाचौँ ॥
en: Then advancing all on a sudden, he with his nails and sharp teeth cut off the ears and nose of that lord of the enemies of the gods and split both his sides with the blow of his feet.

sa: ये च तेऽनुचराः सर्वे पादोपान्तं समाश्रिताः। माठरारुणदण्डाद्यास्तांस्तान् वन्देऽशनिक्षुभान्॥ क्षुभया सहिता मैत्री याश्चान्या भूतमातरः। ताश्च सर्वा नमस्यामि पान्तु मां शरणागतम्॥
en: I bow to all your followers that have taken your feet, (namely) Mathara, Aruna, Danda and others including Asani, Kshubha and others. I also bow to the celestials mothers of all creatures, namely Kshubha and Maitri and to the others of the class. Let them deliver me who am suppliant (at their feet).

sa: प्राप्य ज्ञानं ब्राह्मणात् क्षत्रियाद् वा वैश्याच्छूद्रादपि नीचादनीक्ष्णम्। श्रद्धातव्यं श्रद्दधानेन नित्यं न श्रद्धिनं जन्ममृत्यू विशेताम्॥
en: Acquiring knowledge from a Brahmana or a Kashtriya or Vaishya or even a Shudra who is of low birth, one having faith should always show respect for such knowledge. Birth and death cannot attack one who has faith. arose

sa: शकुन्तलोवाच अयं पुत्रस्त्वया राजन् यौवराज्येऽभिषिच्यताम्। त्वया ह्ययं सुतो राजन् मय्युत्पन्नः सुरोपमः। यथासमयमेतस्मिन् वर्तस्व पुरुषोत्तम॥
en: Shakuntala said : O King, this is your son. Let him be installed as your heir-apparent. O King, this god-like boy was begotten by you on me. O best of men, fulfil now the promise you made of me.

sa: अयत्नसाध्यं मुनयो वदन्ति ये चापि मुक्तास्त उपासितव्याः। त्वया च लोकेन च सामरेण तस्मान्नमस्यामि महर्षिसङ्घान्॥
en: The Sages say that return to Immutable Brahma cannot be attained by Acts. Yourself, others in the world, and the gods too, should respect them who have acquired Liberation. All the great Rishis never desist from culture of Brahma.

sa: दुर्गं जन्म निधनं चापि राजन् न भौतिकं ज्ञानविदो वदन्ति यज्ञैस्तपोभिर्नियमैर्ऋतैश्च दिवं समासाद्य पतन्ति भूमौ॥
en: Birth and death, and other obstacles, O king, men of knowledge say, one cannot get over by ordinary exertion. Men acquire heaven through sacrifices, penances, observances. But they have again to drop down therefrom on the Earth. vows, and

sa: रथिनः सादिनश्चाथ व्यकीर्यन्त सहस्रशः। ततः शान्तनवः क्रुद्धः शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥ नाशयामास सेनां तां भीष्मस्तेषां महात्मनाम्। पञ्चालानां च सैन्यानि शरैर्निन्ये यमक्षयम्॥
en: Then car-warriors and cavalry-soldiers were strewn by thousand on the filed of battle. Thereupon excited with wrath, the son of Shantanu namely Bhishma, with straightknotted shafts, began to slay the troops of the high-souled Pandavas. with his arrows he also dispatched to the regions of Death the troops belonging to the Panchala Princes.

sa: इदं हि तेजस्तव यद् दुरत्ययं तदेव जिज्ञासितुमिच्छता मया। इमं भवानर्थमभिप्रचोदितो वृणीष्व किं चेदपरं व्यवस्यसि॥
en: I acted thus only as a matter of joke. I asked you to do this only with the object of knowing whether you had the power to hurl this rod. Do you ask of me now anything you like.

sa: अनीश्वरं विब्रुवन्त्वार्यमध्ये युधिष्ठिरं तव पाञ्चालि हेतोः। कुर्वन्तु सर्वे चानृतं धर्मराज पाञ्चालि त्वं मोक्ष्यसे दासभावात्॥
en: O Panchali, let them for them for your sake declare in the midst of these most noblemen (present here) that Yudhisthira is not their lord and that he is a liar; you will then be freed from the slavery.

sa: शुष्कं तर्कं परित्यज्य आश्रयस्व श्रुतिं स्मृतिम्। एकाक्षराभिसम्बद्धं तत्त्वं हेतुभिरिच्छसि। बुद्धिर्न तस्य सिद्ध्येत साधनस्य विपर्ययात्॥
en: Abandoning dry discussion, take to Smriti and Shruti. Seek with the help of your reason the knowledge of the undying one who is without a second. One's search (for a thing) becomes in vain from the defect of means.

sa: सा हि गौतमवाक्येन दुर्निरीक्ष्या बभूव ह। त्रयाणामपि लोकानां यावद् रामस्य दर्शनम्। शापस्यान्तमुपागम्य तेषां दर्शनमागता॥
en: And by virtue of Gautama's word, she had been incapable of being seen by any in the three worlds, till the sight of Rāma. And now the curse having come to an end, she could be perceived by them.

sa: ये चास्य दारुणाः केचिद् ग्रहाः सूर्यादयो दिवि। ते चास्य सौम्या जायन्ते शिवाः शिवतराः सदा॥
en: Those planets in the sky including the sun that may be inauspicious and hostile towards him soon become favourable and auspicious towards him for his these acts. And those that are auspicious and favourable become more auspicious and favourable.

sa: ततो गान्धारकैर्गुप्तं पुष्टैरश्वैर्जये धृतम्॥ आससाद रणे यान्तं सहदेवोऽथ सौबलम्।
en: Then Sahadeva attacked Subala's son as the latter, who was still sanguine of success, was flying away guarded by the picked cavalry of the Gandharas.

sa: स्वमंशमवशिष्टं तं संस्मृत्य शकुनि नृप॥ रथेन काञ्चनाङ्गेन सहदेवः समभ्ययात्।
en: Recollecting, O king, that Shakuni, who had to be slain by him, was still alive, Sahadeva, on his car adorned with gold, pursued that warrior.

sa: स तं महामेधनिकाशरूपमुत्पाट्य गच्छन्युधि कुम्भकर्णः। रराज मेरुप्रतिमानरूपो मेरुर्यथा व्युच्छ्रितघोरशृङ्गः॥
en: Kumbhakarņa, who resembled a mountain in loftiness of stature, while taking him away like a mass of cloud appeared like Sumeru overtopped with lofty peaks.

sa: तेष्वेवं हतशेषेषु राक्षसेषु हनूमता। किमन्यदत्र कर्तव्यं गृहीत्वा याम जानकीम्॥
en: What else is there for us to perforin than brining the daughter of the king Janaka when the Rākşasa crew shall be slain by Hanumān?

sa: ब्रूयाश्चैनं कथान्ते त्वं पर्णादवचनं यथा। प्रतिवाक्यं च सुश्रोणि बुद्ध्येथास्त्वमनिन्दिते॥
en: O one of beautiful waist, unblameable one, after you have finished your enquiry, tell him the words of Parnada and understand his reply to them.

sa: जानन्नपि समर्थं मां रक्षसामपवारणे। अनेन क्रोधवाक्येन मैथिल्या निर्गतो भवान्॥
en: Although you knew (full well) that I was able to withstand the Rākşasas, yet did you sally out at the angry words of Mithila's daughter.

sa: तच्छिरः सशिरस्त्राणां लक्ष्मणेषुप्रमर्दितम्। पपात सहसा भूमौ शृङ्ग हिमवतो यथा॥
en: That head furnished with a corsalet, cut off by Laksmana's arrow, suddenly dropped to the earth, like a summit of Himavān toppling (to the ground).

sa: योऽवधीत् केतुमान् वीरो राजपुत्रं दुरासदम्। अपरान्तगिरिद्वारे द्रोणात् कस्तं न्यवारयत्॥
en: Thai heroic Ketumat, who slew the Prince Durjaya when the took sheller in Girivraja, what hero of my army kept him (Ketumat) away from Drona?

sa: आविद्धा सर्ववेगेन भीमेन महती गदा॥ सधूमं सार्चिषं चाग्निं मुमोचोग्रमहास्वना।
en: Meanwhile the massive of Bhimasena, whirled with his entire force, produced a tremendous sound with valleys of smoke, and sparks and flames of fire. mace

sa: ततो दुर्योधनः सर्वानाजुहावाथ पाण्डवान्। युद्धाय भरतश्रेष्ठ देवानिव पुरा बलिः॥
en: Then Duryodhana challenged all the Pandavas to battle, O chief of Bharata's race, like the Asura Vali in days of yore challenging all the celestials.

sa: निहते राक्षसेन्द्रे च सपुत्रामात्यबान्धवे। त्वं समेष्यसि रामेण शशाङ्केनेव रोहिणी॥
en: On the lord of Rākṣasas being slain along with his sons, councillors, and friends, you shall meet with Rāma as Rohiņi meet with the Moon.

sa: अथवा तिष्ठ बीभत्सो सह सर्वैः सहोदरैः। अहमेनं गदापाणिर्जेष्याम्येको महाहवे॥
en: Cr, O Vibhatsu, stay here with all these foremost of men and behold me, alone and armed with the mace, conquer him in fierce battle.

sa: उभयोस्तौ रथौ राजंस्ते चाश्वास्तौ च सारथी॥ रुक्मपुकैः शरैश्छिन्नाश्चित्ररूपा बभुस्तदा।
en: The chariots of both those heroes, O king and their horses and charioteers being pierced with shafts of golden wings, became beautiful to look at.

sa: तं विषण्णं रणे दृष्ट्वा तावकाः पुरुषर्षभ। हार्दिक्यं पूजयामासुर्वासांस्यादुधुवुश्च ह॥
en: Then your troops, O foremost of men, beholding Sikhandin cheerless in battle, began to applaud Hridika's son and they waived their garments in the air.

sa: परदारे न ते बुद्धिर्जातु कार्या कथंचन। विवर्जनं ह्यकार्याणामेतत् सुपुरुषव्रतम्॥
en: Let your heart never be inclined to adultery, because the complete abandonment of all improper acts is ever the duty of those that are good.

sa: ततः प्रहस्य तद् भूतं तत्रैवान्तरधीयत। सह स्त्रीभिर्महाराज पश्यतो मेऽद्धृतोपमम्॥
en: Then, O great king, that being, giving forth a laugh, vanished with the women even at that very spot. And this struck me with wonder.

sa: तत्रापश्यत् तपोवृद्धं वयोवृद्धं च भार्गवम्। अयाचदथ सैन्यार्थं प्राञ्जलिः पृथिवीपतिः॥
en: There did he see Bhrigu's son, old both in years and asceticism. That ruler of earth then with joined hands prayed thus for his favour.

sa: तत्राश्चर्यमभूद् युद्धं सात्वतस्य परैः सह। यदेको वारयामास पाण्डुसेनां दुरासदाम्॥
en: Wonderful was that fierce encounter which took place between the Satwata hero and his foes, since alone hc opposed the invincible ariny of the Pandavas.

sa: प्रययौ रथघोषेण सिंहनादरवेण च। वादित्राणां च निनदैः कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम्॥
en: Proceeded sending up leonine shouts and making his chariot produce a loud rattle. He made the earth tremble with the loud din of musical instruments.

sa: गदाप्रहारं तं घोरमचिन्त्य प्लवगोत्तमः। तां तूष्णीं पातयामास तस्योरसि महामृधे।।४०१
en: Thereat, without thinking at all of the terrific hit of the mace, that best of monkeys in mighty conflict brought down that upon his head.

sa: पृथिवी ज्योतिराकाशमापो वायुश्च पञ्चमः। एतद्योनीनि भूतानि तत्र का परिदेवना॥
en: Earth, light or heat, ether, water, and wind form the fifth-from these do all creatures originate. (When I know this) what sorrow can I feel?

sa: प्रवृद्धनिद्रे शयिते त्वयि राक्षसपांसने। भविष्यन्ति शरण्यानां शरण्या दण्डका इमे॥
en: On you, disgrace of Raksasas, lying down, and being fast asleep, this Dandaka shall be refuge of those that shall resort to it for shelter.

sa: दुर्मुखः श्रुतकर्माणं विद्ध्वा सप्तभिराशुगैः। ध्वजमेकेन चिच्छेद सारथिं चास्य सप्तभिः॥
en: Then Durmukha piercing Shrutakarma with five swift-coursing arrows cut down the latter's standard with a single arrow, and pierced his charioteer also with seven others.

sa: प्रत्युद्याहि रथेनैनं प्रवरं सर्वधन्विनाम्। ततः प्रजविताश्वेन विधिवत् कल्पितेन च॥
en: Encounter this foremost all wielder of bow and drive your car before him.” Then urging to the top of their speed those horses duly equipped.

sa: अस्त्रे ते वारुणाग्नेये ताभ्यां बाणसमाहिते॥ न यावदभ्यपद्येतां व्यावर्तदथ भास्करः।
en: When the Varuna and Agneva weapons were placed on their bow strings just at that moment, the lustrous orb of day went below the horizon.

sa: तत्र निक्षिप्य तान् सर्वानुवाच भरतर्षभः। पानीयं मृगयामीह विश्रमध्वमिति प्रभो॥
en: Placing them all there (under the tree) that best of the Bharata race, (Bhima) said, “O lord, rest here; I shall go to bring water.

sa: अधर्म विद्म काकुत्स्थ अस्मिन्नर्थे नरेश्वर। कथं तिष्ठत्सु ज्येष्ठेषु कनीयानभिषिच्यते॥
en: O lord of men, this does not appear to be in consonance with morality. Wherefore, an elder brother existing, would you install a younger one?

sa: एवं ब्रुवाणा योधास्ते तावका भयपीडिताः। शरपातं समुत्सृज्य स्थिता युद्धदिदृक्षवः॥
en: Speaking such words, your warriors, struck with panic as they were, stood at a distance out of the range of arrows, for witnessing the combat.

sa: परस्परं समासाद्य ब्रह्मदण्डबलात् कृतान्। वृष्णीन् विनष्टांस्ते श्रुत्वा व्यथिताः पाण्डवाभवन्॥
en: Meeting with one another they became greatly stricken with surrow upon hearing that the Vrishnis had met with destruction through the Brahmana's rod of Punishment.

sa: तस्मिन् भग्ने महाराज कृपे शारद्वते युधि। अश्वत्थामाप्यपायासीत् पाण्डवेयाद् स्थान्तरम्॥
en: Then, O great king, Kripa being thus borne away from (the field of battle), Ashvatthaman too fled away in terror from the son of Pandu.

sa: ते शरा हेमपुङ्खाग्रा व्यदृश्यन्त महीतले। विकर्णरुधिरक्लिन्ना वमन्त इव शोणितम्॥
en: Those arrows, with wings and points decorated with gold and bathed in the blood of Vikarna, and stuck on the earth appeared to the vomit-blood.

sa: विग्रहे तुमुले राज्ञां गत्वा पारमसंशयम्। जितं पाण्डुसुतैर्युद्धे नूनं धर्मस्ततोऽधिकः॥
en: Having undoubtedly reached the other shore in that dreadful battle of Kshatriyas, the sons of Pandu have certainly gained the victory and greater a righteousness.

sa: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं पुनरेव सुदारुणम्। तावकानां परेषां च देवासुररणोपमम्॥
en: Then began a battle once more that was highly terrific, between your troops and the enemy, that resembled the one between the gods and demons.

sa: निशीथेऽभ्येत्य चाकस्मादस्मान् स छलयिष्यति कथं च निस्तरेमास्मात् कृच्छ्राद् दैवोपसादितात्॥
en: Yudhisthira said: Coming in the dead of night the ascetics will impose on us; Oh, how can we escape from this difficulty created by destiny.

sa: कश्चिज्ज्ञातीनां बाह्यः पोथयते कुलम्। न मर्षयन्ति तत् सन्तो बाह्येनाभिप्रधर्षणम्॥
en: If any stranger seeks to destroy the honour of a family, they that are good never tolerate such insult to be offered by the stranger.

sa: यच्चाप्यशक्यतां तेषामहतुः पुरुषर्षभौ। तत् तथा पुरुषव्याघ्र तव तद् भद्रमस्तु
en: O best of kings, what these excellent men have said regarding the invincibility of the Pandavas is perfectly true. Do not think otherwise. Be blessed.

sa: पितृदैवतपूजाभिर्ब्राह्मणाभ्यर्चनेन च। अनन्तं पुण्यलोकं तु गन्तासि त्वं न संशयः॥
en: O king, you will certainly go to heaven for your worshipping the Pitris and the celestials and for your showing great reverence to the Brahmanas,

sa: सर्वकामसमृद्धेषु भोगेष्वनुपमेष्विह। भोक्तव्येषु च कल्याणि कस्माद् दास्ये रता ह्यसि॥
en: Having everything of luxury, comfort and enjoyment of no parallel at your command, why do you, O auspicious lady, prefer to remain enchained in servitude?

sa: तावकाश्च महाराज जयं लब्ध्वा महाहवे। पाण्डवेयान् रणे जघ्नुर्द्रवमाणान् समन्ततः॥
en: O monarch, your warriors having been crowned with victory in that dreadful battle began to slaughter the Pandavas as they were flying in all directions.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रुत्वा पाण्डुसुतान् वीरान् बलोद्रिक्तान् महौजसः। धृतराष्ट्रो महीपालश्चिन्तामगमदातुरः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Hearing that the heroic sons of Pandu were endued with great energy and prowess, the king Dhritarashtra became very miserable with anxiety.

sa: तं समुत्क्षिप्य बाहुभ्यां विनर्दित्वा महाबलः। राममुद्दिश्य चिक्षेप हतस्त्वमिति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: And raising up the tree with his arms, and uttering a roar, that exceedingly powerful one aiming at Rāma discharged it, exclaiming, Dead you are.

sa: ततो मुमोच नाराचान् सूतपुत्रः परंतप॥ अशक्यं कर्तुमन्येन सर्वभूतेषु मानद। यदकार्षीत् तदा कर्णः संग्रामे भीमदर्शने॥ स हन्यमानो नाराचैर्धाराभिरिव पर्वतः।
en: Thereafter that afflicter of foes, namely the son of Suta began to shoot his arrows. O giver of honour what Karna then achieved in that battle of fierce aspect was incapable of being achieved by any other creatures. Then struck with his Narachas like a mountain by showers of rain.

sa: न तु पश्यति पश्यंस्तु यश्चैनमनुपश्यति। पञ्चविंशोऽभिमन्येत नान्योऽस्ति परतो मम॥
en: The Souls thinks that there is nothing higher than itself. In sooth, however, though seeing it does not see the Supreme Self which sees it.

sa: राज्यं गतधनं साधो पीतमण्डां सुरामिव। निरास्वाद्यतमं शून्यं भरतो नाभिपत्स्यते॥
en: O righteous one, like to a liquor whose lees alone have been left, Bharata will not receive the kingdom tasteless and denuded of all substance.

sa: स दत्तं केकयेन्द्रेण धनं तन्नाभ्यनन्दत। भरतः केकयीपुत्रो गमनत्वरया तदा॥
en: But owing to the hurry of his departure, Bharata the son of Kaikeyi did not appear to be so very much gratified with the gifts.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वाब्रुवन् देवाः सहस्राक्षमिदं वचः। अस्माननिष्ट्वा क्रतुभिर्भागो नो न भविष्यति॥
en: Hearing Indra's words, the celestials said to their chief having thousand eyes-'Stop the royal sage, O Shakra, by granting him a boon, if you can.

sa: उभौ लोकावभिप्रेक्ष्य राजानमृषयः स्वयम्। असृजन् सुमहद् भूतमयं धर्मो भविष्यति॥
en: Looking on both the worlds, the Rishis made the king, that best of men, with a view that he should be righteousness incarnate on Earth.

sa: तं कर्णः पञ्चविंशत्या नाराचेन समार्पयत्। मदोत्कटं वने दृप्तमुल्काभिरिव कुञ्जरम्॥
en: Then Karna struck him with twenty-five arrows like a hunter striking a proud and infuriate elephant in the forest with a number of blazing brands.

sa: इति मातङ्गवचनं परीप्सन्ति हितेप्सवः। धर्माय चैव प्रणमेद् ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च मद्विधः॥
en: This saying of Matanga is followed by those that desire their own good; men ſike me bow only to Brahmanas for the sake of virtue.

sa: रुधिरेण समुन्मिश्रमस्थिवर्षं तथैव च। रुदतां वाहनानां च नेत्रेभ्यः प्रापतज्जलम्॥
en: Tears dropped from the eyes of the animals that were all weeping; and O ruler of men, preyed upon by anxiety, they frequently discharged urine.

sa: नैतदन्ये करिष्यन्ति भविष्या वसुधाधिपाः॥ यत् त्वं कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ दुष्करं कृतवानसि।
en: Future kings also will never be able to perform so difficult a feat. O foremost one of Kuru's race, as this which you have done.

sa: सुवर्णपुलाञ्छत्रुघ्नान् खेचरान् राक्षसान् प्रति॥ तद् बाणैरर्दितं यूथं रक्षसां पीनवक्षसाम्।
en: Furnished with golden wings, capable of slaying foes and ranging through the welkin at those Rakshasas. Afflicted with those shafts that host of broad-chested Rakshasas.

sa: शोभमानां ध्वजे चास्य वेदीमद्राक्ष्म भारत। हिमवच्छिखराकारां चरतः संयुगे भृशम्॥
en: As he careered with speed in that battle, the device of an altar decorating his banner, O Bharata, appeared like the crest of the Himalayas.

sa: एष धर्मभृताः श्रेष्ठो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। तिष्ठत्यसुकरः संख्ये परैः परपुरञ्जयः॥
en: There stands the impartial king Yudhishthira, the foremost of the pious and the conqueror of enemies' cities. The enemies can never resist him in battle.

sa: स कक्ष्या धन्विभिर्गुप्तास्तिस्रोऽतिक्रम्य वाजिभिः। पदातिरपरे कक्ष्ये द्वे जगाम नरोत्तमः॥
en: Dasaratha's son, the best of men, crossed in his chariot three apartments guarded by warriors with bows in their hands, and other two of foot.

sa: त्रैलोक्यस्य समस्तस्य शक्ताः क्रुद्धो निवारणे। बिभूति सदृशं रूपं युगान्ताग्निसमप्रभम्॥
en: He bears such a form, burning like the fire of dissolution, as it appears that he, when angered, is capable of resisting the three worlds.

sa: ततः पुरुषशार्दूलस्तद् धनं लक्ष्मणः स्वयम्। यथोक्तं ब्राह्मणेन्द्राणामददाद् धनदो यथा॥
en: Thereupon Laksmana, that best of men, distributed amongst all these Brāhmaṇas all the entire riches as ordered by Rāma like to the Lord of wealth.

sa: ते दृष्ट्वा देहमाहात्म्यं कुम्भकर्मोऽयमुत्थितः। भयार्ता वानराः सर्वे संश्रयन्ते परस्परम्॥
en: Seeing the magnitude of his person, the monkeys thinking that it was Kumbhakarna who had come, and affrighted thereat, sought the shelter of each other.

sa: तासां सा मेनका नाम ब्रह्मयोनिर्वराप्सराः। दिवः सम्प्राप्य जगतीं विश्वामित्रादजीजनत्॥
en: Amongst them again, Menaka, born of a Brahmana, is the first. Descending from heaven on earth, she gave me birth from her association with Vishvamitra.

sa: चक्ररक्षः कुमारस्तु पञ्चालानां यशस्करः। दधार द्रोणमायान्तं वेलेव सरितां पतिम्॥
en: Thereat the protectors of Yudhishthira's car-wheels namely Kumara, the glory of the Panchala races, resisted the rushing Drona, like the beach opposing the swelling sea.

sa: शुश्रुवे तुमुलः शब्दः क्रोशतामितरेतरम्। पुत्रानन्ये पितॄनन्ये भ्रातृनन्ये च मातुलान्॥
en: A dreadful sound was heard as they challenged one another aloud. Some leaving their sons, some their fathers, some their brothers and some their uncles.

sa: अस्मिंस्तीर्थे महानद्या अद्यप्रभृति मानवः। आप्लुतो वाजिमेधस्य फलं प्राप्स्यति पुष्कलम्॥
en: He said-"From this day, a person, by bathing in this tirtha of the great river Sarasvati, shall reap the great fruit of a horse sacrifice.

sa: वसुधां दारयित्वा च पुनरप्सु न्यमजत॥ अदृश्यत तदा तत्र पुनरुन्मज्जितोऽन्यतः।
en: Tearing through the earth, he dived again into the waters. Once seen here he was next seen rising on the surface at a different place.

sa: एतदर्थमिमौ राजन् महात्मानौ महाद्युती। नोचतुर्विवृतं किंचिन्न ह्येष तव निश्चयः॥
en: Therefore, O king, I think these illustrious and effulgent persons have not certainly said anything that leads to evil. You however do not understand it.

sa: शरैः सहस्रशो विद्धा द्विपाः प्रसृतशोणिताः। अदृश्यन्ताद्रयः काले गौरिकाम्बुस्रवा इव॥
en: Pierced with thousands of shafts and covered with profuse blood, elephants looked like mountains during the rainy season, with red-chalk solution streaming down their sides.

sa: अताडयद् भीमसेनः पार्श्वे दुर्योधनं तदा॥ स विह्वलः प्रहारेण जानुभ्यामगमन्महीम्।
en: Bhimasena then struck Duryodhana on one of his sides. Stupefied at that blow, the latter dropped down on the Earth, supporting himself on his knees.

sa: अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसामनवेक्ष्य च पौरुषम्। मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत् तामसमुच्यते॥
en: Tama Action is that which is performed from delusion, without regard to consequences and with one's own loss and injury as well as of others.

sa: स्तूष्णीभूतान् धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्रः। स्मयन्निवेदं वचनं बभाषे पाञ्चालराजस्य सुतां तदानीम्॥
en: Seeing the sons and grandsons of kings sitting silent, the son of Dhritarashtra (Duryodhana) smiled and spoke thus to the daughter of the Panchala king.

sa: यथा धेनुसहस्त्रेषु वत्सो विन्दति मातरम्। एवं पूर्वकृतं कर्म कर्तारमनुगच्छति॥
en: As the young calf is able to recognise its dam from among a thousand cows, so do the pristinc deeds of a man follow him.

sa: ततस्तं द्रौपदी दृष्ट्वा प्रणम्य परया मुदा। अब्रवीद् वासुदेवाय मुनेरागमनादिकम्॥
en: Thereupon beholding him arrived there Draupadi, in great delight, bowed to him and communicated to Vasudeva the coming of the ascetic and every other thing,

sa: विमुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्य इति चैव निवोधता यथावदध्यात्मविधिरेष वः कीर्तितो मया॥
en: Know also that such a man becomes freed too from all his sins. I have thus described to you duly the doctrine of spiritual science.

sa: रथिनो वानरेन्द्राणां शरैः कालान्तकोपमैः। शिरांसि नर्दतां जह्वः सहसा भीमनिःस्वनाः॥
en: And Räksasa car-warriors by means of arrows resembling the Destroyer himself, cut off the heads of the foremost monkeys who had been setting up roars.

sa: हितार्थं पाण्डुपुत्राणां कुण्डले मे प्रयाचितुम्। तन्मे कीर्तिकरं लोके तस्याकीर्तिर्भविष्यति॥
en: The ear-rings for the good of the sons of Pandu, then the whole world will be redolent of my fame and will proclaim his infamy.

sa: याज्ञसेनी सुदेष्णां तु श्रुश्रूषन्ती विशाम्पते। आवसत् परिचारार्हा सुदुःखं जनमेजय॥
en: O lord of people, Yajnaseni, although herself worthy of being served by others, began to live, O Janamejaya, in great misery by waiting upon Sudeshna.

sa: घटोत्कचो विनिर्भिन्नः सूतपुत्रेण मर्मसु॥ चक्रं दिव्यं सहस्रारमगृह्णाद् व्यथितो भृशम्।
en: Pierced in his vital parts and extremely pained by the son of Suta, Ghatotkacha took up a discus of celestial make having a thousands pokes.

sa: अथासौ मृदुयुद्धेन न मुञ्चेद् भीम कौरवान्। सर्वोपायैविमोच्यास्ते निगृह्य परिपन्थिनः॥
en: If the Gandharvas do not let off the Kurus, even then, O Bhima, you must then rescue them by crushing the enemy by all means.

sa: प्रातरेष्याम्यथेत्युक्त्वा कदाचिद् द्विजसत्तमः। तत आयाति राजेन्द्र सायं रात्रावथो पुनः॥
en: O king of kings, that foremost of Brahmanas sometimes saying “I will come in the morning" made his appearance in the evening or at night.

sa: ततोऽभिवाद्य तान् वृद्धान् द्विजानाश्रमवासिनः। तैश्चाभिपूजितः सर्वैः प्रययौ नगरं प्रति॥
en: Then the king having greeted all the aged Brahmanas inhabiting the hermitage and in his turn being greeted by them, set out for his capital.

sa: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वं विविधमिन्द्रियम्। आकाशं प्रथमं भूतं श्रोत्रमध्यात्ममुच्यते॥
en: I shall, after this, enumerate all the various orgains. Space (or Ether) is the first. As connected with the soul, it is called the ear.

sa: तस्यान्ववाये द्वौ राजन् राजानौ सम्वभूवतुः। हैहयस्तालजंघश्च वत्सस्य जयतां वर॥
en: In Sharyati's family, O monarch, two kings were born viz., Haihaya and Talajangha. Both of them were sons of Vatsa, O foremost of victorious kings.

sa: विज्ञायैतन्निशायुद्धं जिघांसुर्भीममाहवे। स मत्त इव मातङ्गः संक्रुद्धः इव चोरगः॥
en: Now informed of this nocturnal battle he came there desirous of compassing the death of Bhima. Then like an infuriate elephant or an enraged snake.

sa: स तान् ज्यामुखनिर्मुक्तैर्बहुभिः सुबहूशरान्। चिच्छेद पाण्डवो राजंस्ते भूमौ न्यपतंस्तदा॥
en: With numberless arrows shot from his own bowstring, the son of Pandu, O king, cut off those clouds of arrows upon which they fell down.

sa: स शरैरर्दितस्तेन कर्णेन दृढधन्विना। धनुर्ध्यामच्छिनत् तूर्ण भीमस्तस्य क्षुरेण ह॥
en: Thus through then quickly covered with arrows by that resolute bowman namely Karna, yet that son of Pandu smilingly cut-off the bow-string of the former.

sa: ततोऽन्यद् धनुरादाय वेगवत् सुमहास्वनम्। भीमसेनो रणे क्रुद्धो हार्दिक्यं समवारयत्॥
en: Thereafter, taking up another bow of great toughness and emitting loud twang, the enraged Bhimasena in that battle began to resist the son of Hridika.

sa: अन्योन्यमतिमास्थाय यत्र संप्रतिभाष्यते। न चैकमत्ये श्रेयोऽस्ति मन्त्रः सोऽधम उच्यते॥
en: That one is the worst in which the counsellors differ from each other and agree a little in the long run, with no good result.

sa: पुष्करार्थं कृतं स्तैन्यं पुरा भरतसत्तम। राजर्षिभिर्महाराज तथैव च द्विजर्षिभिः॥
en: O best of the Bharatas, the act of theft had been committed by Indra, and the oaths were taken by many royal and twiceborn Rishis.

sa: अद्य त्वयाहं सौमित्रे बालेनापि पराक्रमैः। तोषितो गन्तुमिच्छामि त्वामनुज्ञाप्य राघवम्॥
en: But today, O Sumitra's son, albeit a boy, you have gratified me with you prowess. Now taking your leave, I wish to go to Rāghava.

sa: भीष्मं योद्धृममीप्सन्तः संग्रामे विजयैषिणः। क्ष्वेडाः किलकिलाः शङ्खान् क्रकचान् गोविषाणिकाः।।
en: With their war-cries and confused uproars and the blarc of Krakachas and sound of drums, cymbals, cow-horns, and panavas, and the roars of their elephants.

sa: कथं दशरथाज्जातः शुभाभिजनकर्मणः। जानन् धर्ममधर्मं च कुर्यां कर्म जुगुप्सितम्॥
en: How having sprung from Dasaratha of righteous deeds and born of immaculate race, and knowing virtue and vice, can I commit such a reprehensible action?

sa: कृत्वा चाध्ययन तेषां शिष्याणां शतमुत्तमम्। विप्रियार्थं सशिष्यस्य मातुलस्य महात्मनः॥
en: I then taught them to a hundred competent disciples and thereby did what disagreeable to my great maternal uncle (Vaishampayana) with the disciples round him.

sa: तस्मिन्काले सुमित्रायाः पुत्रः परबलार्दनः। चकार लक्ष्मणः क्रुद्धो युद्धं परपुरंजयः॥
en: At this moment, that subduer of hostile hosts and captor of the capitals of foes-Sumitra's son-Laksmana, growing enraged, entered on an encounter with the enemy.

sa: अधिरुह्य ततो वीरः पर्वतं पवनात्मजः॥ ददर्श सागरं भीमं भीमोरगनिषेवितम्।
en: And getting to the top of the mountain, that hero, son to the Wind-god, cast his eyes upon the dreadful main inhabited by terrible snakes.

sa: निर्जित्य पृथिवीपालानथं भीष्मो गजाह्वयम्। आजगाम विशुद्धात्मा कन्याभिः सह भारतः॥
en: Bhishma of sinless soul, having conquered those rulers of the earth came to the city called after the elephant in company with those girls, OBharata.

sa: यावन्न चरणौ भ्रातुः पार्थिवव्यञ्जनान्वितौ। शिरसा प्रग्रहीष्यामि न मे शान्तिर्भविष्यति॥
en: So long as I do not take on my head those feet of my brother bearing royal marks, I shall not attain peace of mind.

sa: भिक्षुरूपं परित्यज्य वानरं रूपमास्थितः। पृष्ठमारोप्य तौ वीरो जगाम कपिकुञ्जरः॥
en: Renouncing the guise of a beggar, and assuming the form of a monkey, that foremost of monkeys went away, placing those heroes on his back.

sa: तारिता नरशार्दूल दिवं याताश्च देववत्। षष्ठिः पुत्रसहस्राणि सगरस्य महात्मनः॥
en: O most puissant of men, the sixty thousand sons of the high-souled Sagara have been delivered and they have ascended heaven like to celestials themselves.

sa: सर्वत्र खलु दृश्यन्ते साधवो धर्मचारिणः। शूराः शरण्याः सौमित्रे तिर्यग्योनिगतेष्वपि॥
en: In every status of animal creation, the heroic, the righteous and the honest, affording refuge to all, are to be found, even among the birds.

sa: पदातिनौ च यानाविदुःखाही सुखोचितौ। दृष्ट्वा संचोदयामास शीघ्रं याहीति सारथिम्॥
en: And seeing his parents deserving of comfort and worthy of going in a carriage, going on foot, Rāma said to the charioteer, "Go you swiftly.”

sa: तस्मात् तु मिथुनादेकं पुमांसं पापनिश्चयः। जघान वैरनिलयो निषादस्तस्य पश्यतः॥
en: At this juncture, a wicked-minded fowler, singling out the male, without any cause of hostility, slew him in the very presence of the holy man.

sa: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा कौसल्या हृदयङ्गमम्। शुद्धसत्त्वा मुमोचाश्रु सहसा दुःखहर्षजम्॥
en: Hearing Sītā's words which went directly to the heart, Kausalyā endued with purity of spirit, out of fullness of bliss and bale suddenly shed tears.

sa: पताकिन्यस्तु ता नावः स्वयं दाशैरधिष्ठिताः। वहन्त्यो जनमारूढं तदा सम्पेतुराशुगाः॥
en: Then those boats hung with pennons, managed by the kinsfolk (of Guha), set off at speed with the teeming folks that had got on board.

sa: विज्ञाय रामस्य वचः सौमित्रिमित्रनन्दनः। गुहमामन्त्र्य सूतं च सोऽतिष्ठद् भ्रातुरग्रतः॥
en: Hearing Rāma's words, that enhancer of the delight of friends, Sumitra's son, conveyed them to Guha and the charioteer; and then stood before his brother.

sa: तथानुयाने काकुत्स्थ मत्ता नर्दन्तु कुञ्जराः। अन्तःपुरगता नार्यो नन्दन्तु सुसमाहिताः॥
en: O Kākutstha, let mad elephants roar, with the view of following you; and let the women of the inner apartments with concentrated rainds utter jubilation.

sa: अभिगम्य च धर्मज्ञा रामं धर्मभृतां वरम्। ऊचुः परमधर्मज्ञमृषिसङ्घाः समागताः॥
en: And coming before Rāma, the foremost of those practising righteousness, those sages conversant with morality, met in a body, said to that pre-eminently virtuous one,

sa: सा बहून्यमनोज्ञानि वाक्यानि हृदयच्छिदाम्। अहं श्रोष्ये सपत्नीनामवराणां परा सती॥
en: Myself, being the eldest of all the queens, shall have to hear unpleasant and heart-rending words from the co-wives who are all younger than I.

sa: एतावद् वानरैः शक्यं गन्तुं वानरपुङ्गवाः। अभास्करममर्यादं न जानीमस्ततः परम्॥
en: You foremost of monkeys, the monkeys are competent to proceed thus far. Beyond this, of the tract without sun and without limit, I know nothing.

sa: अनभिज्ञा वनानां सा नूनं भयमुपैष्यति। श्वपदानर्दितं श्रुत्वा गम्भीरं रोमहर्षणम्॥
en: Unacquainted with the forest, she is certainly afflicted with fright on hearing the deep roars of ferocious beasts, capable of making one's hair stand erect.

sa: ततः शून्यां गतजनां वसुधां त्वमेका शाधि दुर्वृत्ता प्रजानामहिते स्थिता॥
en: Then alone you of vile ways and intent upon harming the people will govern this empty earth deserted by the inhabitants, along with the trees.

sa: पितुर्ग्रहीष्ये पादौ च तं ममाख्याहि पृच्छतः। आहोस्विदम्बाज्येष्ठायाः कौसल्याया निवेशने॥
en: I would take the feet of my father. Do you tell me who ask you. Is he in the apartment of my eldest mother, Kausalya?

sa: जज्ञेऽथ तासां संनादः क्रौञ्चीनामिव निःस्वनः। मानवेन्द्रस्य भार्याणामेवं वदति राघवे॥
en: As Rāghava was speaking thus, there arose a loud wail proceeding from those wives of that chief of men, like to the cries of Krauncis.

sa: ततः शूर्पणखा दीना रावणं लोकरावणम्। अमात्यमध्ये संक्रुद्धा परुषं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then the woe began Śūrpanakhā, in high wrath spoke harshly in the midst of the courtiers, to Rāvana, given to railing loudly against all creatures.

sa: इति प्रशस्यमाना सा कैकेयीमिदमब्रवीत्। शयानां शयने शुभ्रे वेद्यामग्निशिखामिव ॥
en: Thus praised by Kaikeyi, as she was lying down on a white bed, like to fire up on the sacrificial dais, Manthară addressed her, saying.

sa: इदं पुण्यमिदं रम्यमिदं बहुमृगद्विजम्। इह वत्स्याम सौमित्रे सार्धमेतेन पक्षिणा॥
en: This spot is sacred-this spot is charmingthis spot abounds in beasts and birds. Here will I dwell, O Sumitra's son, in company with this birds.

sa: नीललोहितमाञ्जिष्ठपद्मवर्णैः सितासितैः। स्वभावसिद्धैर्विमलैर्धातुभिः समलंकृतम्॥ कामरूपिभिराविष्टमभीक्ष्णं सपरिच्छदैः। यक्षकिन्नरगन्धर्वैर्देवकल्पैः सपन्नगैः॥ स तस्य गिरिवर्यस्य तले नागवरायुते। तिष्ठन् कपिवरस्तत्र हृदे नाग इवाबभौ॥
en: There were various minerals on the Mahendra hill was shining by rosy, ruby-like and white and black hues, which was constantly visited by Yaksas, Kinnaras,, Gandharvas, Nāgas resembling to the celestials capable in their pristine lustre, there Hanumān standing at its foot looked like an elephant immersed in a lake!

sa: तमः भ्रातरं कृत्वा रामो वचनमब्रवीत्। श्यामं नलिनपत्राक्षं मत्तहंसस्वरः स्वयम्॥
en: Taking on his lap that sable-hued on furnished with eyes resembling lotus-leaves, Rāma with a voice like that of a mad swan, spoke to (Bharata).

sa: रेणुशोणितसंवीतं गात्रं तव समन्ततः॥ परिरब्धुं न शक्नोमि भुजाभ्यां प्लवगर्षभ।
en: Your body is on all sides besmeared with blood and dust and I am incapable of embracing you with my arms, O best of monkeys.

sa: चतुर्दशसु वर्षेषु गतेषु नृपसत्तम। पुनर्द्रक्ष्यसि मां प्राप्तं संतापोऽयं विमुच्यताम्॥
en: O best of monarchs, after the fourteen years have been spent, you will see me again by your side, therefore do you banish this grief.

sa: रामस्त्वनेन वाक्येन सुप्रीतः प्रत्युवाच तम्। व्रजापृच्छस्व सौमित्रे सर्वमेव सुहृज्जनम्॥
en: Being extremely gratified with these words, Rāma spoke to him, saying, Do you follow me, O son of Sumitrā, obtaining permission from all your relatives.

sa: तास्तु कन्यास्ततः प्रीतः कश्यपः पुनरब्रवीत्॥ पुत्रांस्त्रैलोक्यभतृन् वै जनयिष्यथ मत्समान्।
en: Then, well pleased Kaśyapa again said to those damsels, Do you bring forth sons like to myself, who shall be lords of the three worlds.

sa: ततः स रौद्राभिरतः प्रमत्तोऽधर्मकर्षितः। तस्य शस्त्रस्य संवासाज्जगाम नरकं मुनिः॥
en: Thus in consequence of bearing that weapon, that ascetic taken up with fierce thoughts, losing his sobriety and led astray from righteousness, went to hell.

sa: राम धर्ममिमं प्रेक्ष्य कुलधर्मानुसंततम्। कर्तुमर्हसि काकुत्स्थ मम मातुश्च याचनाम्॥
en: O Rāma, taking into account the morality of this race, it behoves you to act in accordance with the solicitations of my mother (and yours).

sa: एतदन्यच्च करुणं विलप्य विजने बहु। अश्रुपूर्णमुखो दीनो निशि तूष्णीमुपाविशत्॥
en: Having in solitude for a long while piteously bewailed thus and in other ways, Rāma sat silent in the night with tears in his eyes.

sa: वीर्यहीनमिवाशक्तं क्षत्रधर्मेण भार्गव। अवजानासि मे तेजः पश्य मेऽद्य पराक्रमम्॥
en: But, O Bhargava, you insulted me abiding by the Kșatriya duties, as pusillaniinous or devoid of prowess. Do you to-day witness my energy and vigour.

sa: ऐणेयं मांसमाहृत्य शालां यक्ष्यामहे वयम्। कर्तव्यं वास्तुशमनं सौमित्रे चिरजीविभिः॥
en: Procuring meat, we will worship the deity presiding over this dwelling. O Sumitrā's son, those who wish to live long, should pacify the household gods.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणस्य तपोधनः। तथेत्युक्त्वाऽग्निशरणं प्रविवेश निवेदितुम्॥
en: Hearing Laksmana's words, that ascetic, saying, “So be it," entered the chamber of the sacrificial fire, for the purpose of communicating (the news to Agastya).

sa: शर्वरीं भगवनद्य सत्यशील तवाश्रमे। उषिताः स्मोऽह वसतिमनुजानातु नो भवान्॥
en: O reverend sire of truthful character, we have here in your asylum spent the night. Do you now permit us to set forward (for Citrakuta).

sa: ततः शूर्पणखावाक्यं तच्छ्रुत्वा रोमहर्षणाम्। सचिवानभ्यनुज्ञाय कार्यं बुद्ध्वा जगाम ह॥
en: Hearing those words of Śūrpanakhā, able to make one's hair stand on end, (Ravana) ascertaining his course after issuing his orders to this counsellors, departed.

sa: स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल समानय सुसत्कृतम्। स्वयमेव महाराज गत्वा सबलवाहनः॥
en: Therefore, do you, O tiger among men, repairing there, accompanied with your forces and equipage, yourself, O mighty king, bring Rşyasſrga over with due honours.

sa: शराणां धनुषश्चाहमनृणोऽस्मिन् महावने। ससैन्यं भरतं हत्वा भविष्यामि न संशयः॥
en: I will, without doubt, in this forest pay the debt I owe to my bow and arrows, by slaying Bharata together with all his forces.

sa: भीषणोऽयं महाकायो राक्षसो भुजविक्रमः। लोकं ह्यतिजितं कृत्वा ह्यावां हन्तुमिहेच्छति॥
en: This grim-visaged Raksasas, of huge proportions, gifted only with the strength of arms, defeating all other persons, has addressed itself at last to destroy us.

sa: अस्वाधीनं कथं दैवं प्रकारैरभिराध्यते। स्वाधीनं समतिक्रम्य मातरं पितरं गुरुम्॥
en: Why should with meditations and adorations worship Destiny, which is not cognizable to the worshippers, neglecting our parents, who are ever present to our senses?

sa: रामश्च सीतया सार्धं विजहार बहूनृतून्॥ मनस्वी तद्गतमनास्तस्या हृदि समर्पितः।
en: In the company of Sītā, the wise Rāma, bending his mind to Sītā, with his heart dedicated to her, passed many a season in delight.

sa: सोऽत्रेराश्रममासाद्य तं ववन्दे महायशाः। तं चापि भगवानत्रिः पुत्रवत् प्रत्यपद्यत॥
en: And having arrived at Atri's asylum, that renowned one paid obeisance (to the sage); and the reverend Atri also on his pare received Rāma asason.

sa: प्रतिजानामि ते सत्यमायुधं चाहमालभे। यथा रामं वधिप्यामि वधार्ह सर्वरक्षसाम्॥
en: I swear (to you) truly; I touch this weapon, (to say) that I will stay Rāma, who deserves to be slain by all the Rākşasas.

sa: तेषां तपःप्रभावेण पश्याद्यापि रघूत्तम। द्योतयन्ती दिशः सर्वाः श्रिया वेद्यतुलप्रभा॥
en: Behold, O best of Raghus, this alter of incomparable beauty, by virtue of their asceticism, has been still shedding its lustre on all the sides.

sa: सा तदा करुणा वाचो विलपन्ती सुदुःखिता। वनस्पतिगतं गृधं ददर्शायतलोचना॥
en: Racked with sorrow that one of expansive eyes, while thus bewailing in piteous accents, she espied Jațāyu, the king of vultures, seated on a tree.

sa: नियतिः कारणं लोके नियतिः कर्मसाधनम्। नियतिः सर्वभूतानां नियोगेष्विह कारणम्॥
en: Time is the prime cause in this world, and the source of the accomplishment of actions. And Time it is that leads men to actions.

sa: तर्पयित्वाथ सलिलैस्तैः पितॄन् दैवतानपि। स्तुवन्ति स्मोदितं सूर्य देवताश्च तथानघाः।॥
en: Then having offered his adorations with water to the gods and the pitrs, those sinless ones hymned the risen sun as well as the celestials.

sa: यस्मिंस्तु दिवसे राजा चक्रे गोदानमुत्तमम्। तस्मिंस्तु दिवसे वीरो युधाजित् समुपेयिवान्॥ पुत्रः केकयराजस्य साक्षाद्भरतमातुलः। दृष्ट्वा पृष्ट्वा च कुशलं राजानमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: And it came to pass that the day on which the king made excellent presents of kine, the heroic Yudhājit, son to the lord of the Kekayas and maternal uncle to Bharata, presented himself before Dasaratha. And having seen the king and enquired after his welfare, he said to him.

sa: भगवन् दृष्टवीर्यो मे रामो दशरथात्मजः। अत्यद्भुतमचिन्त्यं च अतर्कितमिदं मया॥
en: O worshipful one, I have beheld the prowess of Dasaratha's son. This is verily wonderful and inconceivable; and I did not think this was possible.

sa: भरतस्य वचः श्रुत्वा पुरुषाः शस्त्रपाणयः। विविशुस्तद्वनं शूरा धूमाग्रं ददृशुस्ततः॥
en: Hearing Bharata's speech, persons with weapons in their hands, plunged into the forest, and those heroes presently discovered the top of a (column of) smoke.

sa: आनृशंस्यमनुक्रोशः श्रुतं शीलं दमः शमः। राघवं शोभयन्त्येते षड्गुणाः पुरुषर्षभम्॥
en: Universal benevolence, kindness, learning, goodness, the restraint of the senses, and the control of the faculties, these six qualities adorn that best of men, Rāghava.

sa: श्वः प्रभाते नरेन्द्र त्वं संवर्तयितुमर्हसि ॥ यज्ञस्यान्ते नरश्रेष्ठ विवाहमृषिसत्तमैः।
en: O lord of men, to-morrow morning after the completion of the sacrifice, do you perform the nuptials, in company with the foremost of the saints.

sa: त्वयाऽशेषो जनश्चायं समाश्वास्यो यतोऽनघे। किमिदानीमिदं देवि करोषि हृदि विक्लवम्॥
en: O sinless one, it is for you to console these people. Why then, O revered one, do you suffer your heart to be thus overpowered?

sa: अवध्यातश्च रुद्रेण चक्षुणा रघुनन्दन। व्यशीर्यन्त शरीरात् स्वात् सर्वगात्राणि दुर्मतेः॥
en: Thereupon, O descendant of Raghu, uttering a roar, the high-souled Rudra eyed him steadfastly. And thereat all the limbs of that perverse-hearted one became blasted.

sa: कालपाशं समासज्य कण्ठे मोहान बुध्यते। यस्त्वामद्य समासाद्य पीतवान् विषमुत्तमम्॥
en: He that coming in contact with you has to-day drunk virulent poison, winding a fatal noose round about his neck, know it not through ignorance.

sa: इन्द्रमस्यां तु वेलायामभितुष्टाव मातलिः। सोऽजयद् दानवान् सर्वांस्तथा त्वां बोधयाम्यहम्॥
en: The charioteer Mätali used to hymn Indra at this season, and (encouraged by that eulogy) he conquered the Dänavas. Even so do I hymn you.

sa: तयाद्य मम सज्जेऽस्मिन्नभिषेके नृपोद्यते। प्रचोदितः स समयो धर्मेण प्रतिनिर्जितः॥
en: When every thing was made ready by my father for my installation, Kaikeyi reminded him of his promise and gained over him for this righteousness.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु सौमित्रिं सुमन्त्रमपि राघवः। अप्रमत्तस्त्वमश्वेषु भव सौम्येत्युवाच ह॥
en: O Sumitrā's son, I will spend here this night, subsisting alone. Even this recommends itself to me, although the forest yields various kinds of fruits.

sa: उवाच वचनं धीमान् परितोषात् सगद्गदम्। सुनाभं पर्वतश्रेष्ठं स्वयमेव शचीपतिः॥
en: And the thousand-eyed Vásava was also pleased. And greatly pleased that highly intelligent Saci's lord, himself, addressed that best of mountains having picturesque sides, saying.

sa: उपानीयासनं पूर्वं पायेनाभिनिमन्त्र्य च। अब्रवीत् सिद्धमित्येव तदा तं सौम्यदर्शनम्॥
en: Offering him a seat first and afterwards inviting him to wash his feet she said to that one of placid look cooked rice is ready.

sa: पुनरेवं ब्रुवाणं तं भरतं लक्ष्मणाग्रजः। प्रत्युवाच ततः श्रीमाज्ञातिमध्ये सुसत्कृतः॥
en: As Bharata was again ng in this strain, his graceful elder brother, having been highly honoured, answered Bharata in the midst of his relatives, saying.

sa: नन्दिग्रामे जटां हित्वा भ्रातृभिः सहितोऽनघः। रामः सीतामनुप्राप्य राज्यं पुनरवाप्तवान्॥
en: Having arrived at Nandigrāma, the sinless Rāma sheared himself of his matted locks along with his brothers, and having regained Sītā, got back his kingdom

sa: नहि प्रव्रजिते रामे जीविष्यति महीपतिः। मृते दशरथे व्यक्तं विलोपस्तदनन्तरम्॥
en: On Rāma retiring to the forest, the lord of earth will surely not live; and Dasaratha dying, it is evident everything will come to naught.

sa: सा पद्मपीता हेमाभा रावणं जनकात्मजा। विद्युद् घनमिवाविश्य शुशुभे तप्तभूषणा॥
en: Janaka's daughter, yellow-hued like lotus, having the lustre of gold-and adorned with shining ornaments, coming in contact with Rāvana, appeared like lightning embosomed among clouds.

sa: नाथवांश्च शुन:शेपो यज्ञस्याविघ्नतो भवेत्। देवतास्तर्पिताश्च स्युर्मम चापि कृतं वचः॥
en: Thus Sunaḥsepa will obtain protection, the sacrifice will be freed from hindrance the deities will be propitiated, and finally my word will be made good.

sa: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य यक्षिणी कारूपिणी॥ बलं नागसहस्रस्य धारयन्ती तदा ह्यभूत्।
en: Then after a space of time, was born a Yakşīņi capable of assuming forms at will, and endowed with the strength of a thousand elephants.

sa: अभिभूतमिदं सर्वं विद्रुतं वानरं बलम्। अस्मिन् प्लवगशार्दूले हते शक्रसमप्रभे॥
en: That king of monkeys, having Sakra's prowess, being made away with this host of monkeys have been taking to their heels being overwhelmed with consternation.

sa: स हतान् दृश्य रामेण स्वाँलोकांस्तपसार्जितान्। जामदग्न्यो जगामाशु महेन्द्रं पर्वतोत्तमम्॥
en: And witnessing the destruction by Rāma of his regions earned by his own austerities, Jamadagni's son speedily started for that best of mountains, the Mahendra.

sa: अतीत्यैकादशाहं तु नामकर्म तथाकरोत्। ज्येष्ठं रामं महात्मानं भरतं कैकयीसुतम्॥ सौमित्रिं लक्ष्मणमिति शत्रुघ्नमपरं तथा। वसिष्ठः परमप्रीतो नामानि कुरुते तदा॥
en: When the eleventh day had gone by, the king performed the Naming ceremony of his sons. And experiencing great delight, Vasistha conferred the names. And the high-souled eldest one was called Rāma; and Kaikeyi's son was called Bharata; and Sumitrā's son was called Laksmana, and the last was named Satrughna.

sa: अवतीर्य च विन्ध्याग्रात् कृच्छ्रेण विषमाच्छनैः। तीक्ष्णदर्भा वसुमती दुःखेन पुनरागतः॥
en: Descending with difficulty from the uneven top of Vindhya, I again came* to the earth covered with sharp-pointed grass. *While the saint was staying here.

sa: तमिन्द्रं मलिनं देवा ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः॥ कलशैः स्नापयामासुर्मलं चास्य प्रमोचयन्।
en: When Indra had been thus besmeared, the deities, and the saints having asceticism for wealth, washed him here, and cleansed his person from the dirt.

sa: एवमस्मि तदा मुक्तः सहायास्ते निपातिताः। अकृतास्त्रेण रामेण बालेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा ॥
en: Myself saved thus, my followers however all killed by Rāma of unwearied activity though a mere child and a novice in the are of warfare.

sa: क्रियतां शिल्पिभिः पन्थाः समानि विषमाणि च। रक्षिणश्चानुसंयातु पथि दुर्गविचारकाः॥
en: Let workmen lay out level roads in uneven tracts; and let those men that are adepts in threading places difficult to pass through, follow us.

sa: मखदंष्ट्रायुधाः सर्वे सर्वे सर्वास्त्रकोविदाः। विचालयेयुः शैलेन्द्रान् भेदयेयुः स्थिरान् द्रुमान्॥
en: And they fought with nails and teeth, and were accomplished in all weapons. And they could move the largest hills, and crush the fixed trees,

sa: कच्चिज्जानपदो विद्वान् दक्षिणः प्रतिभानवान्। यथोक्तवादी दूतस्ते कृतो भरत पण्डितः॥
en: O Bharata, are your spies persons coming from the provinces, and learned, upright, endowed with presence of mind, representing the truth, and possessed of wisdon?

sa: घृतपूर्णेषु कुम्भेषु धात्र्यस्तान् समवर्धयन्। कालेन महता सर्वे यौवनं प्रतिपेदिरे॥
en: And the nurses fostered them by keeping them in jars filled with clarified butter. And after a great length of time, they attained to youth.

sa: ततः सबालवृद्धा सा पुरी परमपीडिता। राममेवाभिदुद्राव घर्तिः सलिलं यथा॥
en: And the entire city containing, young and old, extremely afflicted, rushed after Rāma, like persons oppressed with the heat of the sun rushing towards water.

sa: अनेकवार्षिको यस्तु चिरकालसमुत्थितः। सोऽयमद्य हतः शेते कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः॥
en: He lived for a long time, of an uplifted person, and has now laid low on the earth. None can withstand the course of destiny.

sa: बिलानि दंष्ट्रिणः सर्वे सानूनि मृगपक्षिणः। त्यजन्त्वस्मद्भयाद्रीता गजाः सिंहा वनान्यपि॥
en: Inspired by the fear of us, serpents will leave their holes, and beats and birds the caves of mountains, and elephants and lions the forest.

sa: शरत्कालं प्रतीक्षिष्ये स्थितोऽस्मि वचने तव। सुग्रीवस्य नदीनां च प्रसादमनुपालयन्॥
en: I shall live here, awaiting the autumn and abiding by your words and awaiting as well Sugrīva's pleasure and the clear currents of the rivers.

sa: इहाद्य रजनीं राम वसेम शुभदर्शन। पुण्ययोः सरितोर्मध्ये श्वस्तरिष्यामहे वयम्॥
en: Here, O Rāma, in the midst of the sacred streams, will we spend the night, O you of gracious presence, crossing over on the morrow.

sa: किमेतच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि कारणं यत्कृते पुनः। हा नाथेति विनर्दन्ती सर्पवच्चेष्टसे क्षितौ॥
en: What can it be? I would hear of the occasion owing to which again, crying ‘Ah lord,' you roll on the earth like a serpent.

sa: स भूयः सर्वतः श्रीमान् मारुतिर्यत्नमाश्रितः। आपानभूमिमुत्सृज्य तां विचेतुं प्रचक्रमे॥
en: Leaving the place of was sail, the graceful offspring of the Wind-god, taking extreme care, again began to search for Sītā all about (another quarter).

sa: तृतीयः पुरुषो नास्ति यश्चेरद्बतमीदृशम्। व्रतं सुदुष्करं ह्येतन्मयैवोत्पादितं पुरा ॥
en: A third person there is none that practise such a vow. This vow is hard to perform, and formerly it was I that introduced it.

sa: साधु पश्यामि ते रूपं सुयुक्तं प्रतिकर्मणा। प्रतिकर्माभिसंयुक्ता दाक्षिण्येन वरानने॥
en: I shall behold your dazzling beauty whenadorned with ornaments. For pity to me, do you embellish, yourself with ornaments, O you of a graceful countenance.

sa: इतीव दुःखसंतप्ता विललापायतेक्षणा। भर्तुः शिरो धनुश्चैव ददर्श जनकात्मजा ॥
en: Thus, burning in grief, did that large-eyed one indulge in lamentations; and Janaka's daughter kept fast gazing at the head and bow of her lord.

sa: संपपात त्रिधा छिन्ना शक्तिः काञ्चनमालिनी। सविस्फुलिङ्गा ज्वलिता महोल्केव दिवश्च्युता॥
en: The dart dight with networks of gold fell down in three fragments, as dropped a mighty meteor from the firmament, flaming and shooting out scintillations.

sa: एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवः प्रहस्तेन महाबलः। विवेश नगरी लङ्का भ्रातृभिः सबलानुगैः॥ धनदेन परित्यक्तां सुविभक्तमहापथाम्। आरुरोह स देवारिः स्वर्ग देवाधिपो यथा॥
en: Thus addressed by Prahasta, the redoubtable Ten-necked one, entered the city of Lanka with his brothers and forces and followers. And then even as the lord of the celestials ascends heaven, that foe of the immortals ascended Lanka welldivided by highways, which had been forsaken by the lord of wealth.

sa: स हत्वा राक्षसान् वीरः किंकरान् मारुतात्मजः। युद्धाकाङ्क्षी महावीरस्तोरणं समवस्थितः।॥
en: And having slain those Rākṣasas, who where the retainers of Rāvaņa, the heroic offspring of the Wind-god-foremost of heroes-desirous of fight, stood at the gate.

sa: रात्रियुद्धे तदा पूर्व वज्राशनिसमैः शरैः। शायितौ तौ मया भूयो विसंज्ञौ सपुरःसरौ॥ स्मृतिर्न तेऽस्ति वा मन्ये व्यक्तं या तो यमक्षयम्। आशीविषसमं क्रुद्धं यन्मां योद्धमुपस्थितः॥
en: Formerly in a night-engagement, with my shafts resembling the thunder-bolt and Vajra, you two along with your foremost adherents, were rendered insensible and laid down on the earth by me. But, perhaps, you have forgotten it. As you have presented yourself for battle before me, fired with wrath and resembling a venomous serpent, it is evident you will go to the region of Yama.

sa: अग्न्यामलसंकाशं दिव्यं दृष्ट्वा रथं स्थितम्। आरुरोह महाबाहू रामः परपुरंजयः॥
en: Beholding that celestial car, bright as the fire of the sun, stationed before him, Rama, having long arms, the conqueror of enemies cities, ascended it.

sa: महावीर्यस्य दक्षस्य संयुगेष्वपलायिनः॥ यातुधानस्य दौहि: किं मां न प्रतिभाषसे।
en: I am the grand-daughter of the highly powerful Rākşasa Sumālī who never flies away from the field of battle; why did you not welcome me.

sa: एष सेतुर्मया बद्धः सागरे लवणार्णवे॥ तव हेतोर्विशालाक्षि नलसेतुः सुदुष्करः।
en: O you having expansive eyes, for you, this difficult construction of the bridge was made by me over the deep by the help of Nala.

sa: संनह्य तु ससुग्रीवः कपिराजबलं महत्। कालज्ञो राघवः काले संयुगायाभ्यचोदयत्॥
en: After making the mighty host of the monkeysking equip itself, Raghava versed in season, along with Sugrīva, at the proper hour, issued orders for battle.

sa: श्रुत्वा विश्रवसः पुत्रः पौराणामर्जुनं गतम्॥ अपसृत्यागतो बिन्ध्यं हिमवत्संनिभं गिरिम्।
en: Hearing of the absence of the king from the citizens Viśravasa's son came out of the city and reached the Vindhya mountain resembling the Himalayas.

sa: यस्या ह्येवंविधः स्वप्नो दुःखितायाः प्रदृश्यते। सा दुःखैर्बहुभिर्मुक्ता प्रियं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम्॥
en: Surely shall she, divested of misfortune, he reconciled to her beloved and excellent husband, regarding whom, in her misery, I have dreamt such a dream.

sa: स्वागतं ते महाबाहो कौसल्यानन्दवर्धन। इति प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे नागरा राममब्रुवन्॥
en: Thereupon all the citizens with folded hands welcomed him saying, “Welcome are you, O you of long arms! O you the enhancer of Kausalya's joy!"
